title_en: On the Power of Statistics in Class-Incremental Learning with Pretrained Models
title_zh: 论统计量在基于预训练模型的类增量学习中的作用

sentences.en: Recent class-incremental learning (CIL) methods built on large pre-trained vision models have shown that strong performance can be retained even under strict data access constraints.
sentences.zh: 近期基于大规模预训练视觉模型的类增量学习（CIL）方法表明，即使在严格的数据访问限制下，也能保持强大的性能。

sentences.en: This raises a fundamental question: which properties of pre-trained representations make such recovery possible in the class-incremental setting?
sentences.zh: 这引出一个根本问题：预训练表示的哪些性质使得在类增量设定下实现这种恢复成为可能？

sentences.en: In this work, we show that class-level feature statistics play a central role in enabling effective CIL under strong pre-training.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们表明类级特征统计量在强预训练下实现有效CIL中发挥着核心作用。

sentences.en: When the visual backbone is frozen, maintaining simple class-wise statistical estimators of features can recover a substantial fraction of the performance achieved by static joint training across diverse benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 当视觉骨干被冻结时，维护特征的简单类级统计估计器可以恢复静态联合训练在多个基准上实现的大部分性能。

sentences.en: We make this observation explicit through deliberately minimal reference points built on frozen CLIP representations.
sentences.zh: 我们通过基于冻结CLIP表示构建的刻意最小化参照点来使这一观察显式化。

sentences.en: In particular, we demonstrate that competitive performance can be achieved without continual parameter updates, by performing class-incremental inference based solely on class-level statistical estimators instantiated from frozen features.
sentences.zh: 特别地，我们证明无需持续参数更新也能获得有竞争力的性能，办法是仅基于从冻结特征实例化的类级统计估计器进行类增量推理。

sentences.en: Our findings suggest that class-level statistics constitute an important and previously underemphasized component of recent PTM-based CIL approaches, offering a complementary perspective for understanding their strong empirical performance.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现表明，类级统计量是近期基于PTM的CIL方法中一个重要但此前被低估的组成部分，为理解其强大的经验性能提供了补充视角。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/HdTgon/baseCIL.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/HdTgon/baseCIL 获取。

title_en: On the Provable Suboptimality of Momentum SGD in Nonstationary Stochastic Optimization
title_zh: 论动量SGD在非平稳随机优化中的可证次优性

sentences.en: In this paper, we provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis of Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) and its momentum variants (Polyak Heavy-Ball and Nesterov) for tracking time-varying optima under strong convexity and smoothness.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们对随机梯度下降（SGD）及其动量变体（Polyak重球和Nesterov）在强凸性和光滑性下跟踪时变最优点进行了全面的理论分析。

sentences.en: Our finite-time bounds reveal a sharp decomposition of tracking error into transient, noise-induced, and drift-induced components.
sentences.zh: 我们的有限时间界揭示了跟踪误差分解为瞬态、噪声诱发和漂移诱发三个分量。

sentences.en: This decomposition exposes a fundamental trade-off: while momentum is often used as a gradient-smoothing heuristic, under distribution shift it incurs an explicit drift-amplification penalty that diverges as the momentum parameter $\beta$ approaches 1, yielding systematic tracking lag.
sentences.zh: 这一分解暴露出一个基本权衡：虽然动量常被用作梯度平滑启发式，但在分布偏移下它会招致显式的漂移放大惩罚，且该惩罚随动量参数 $\beta$ 趋近1而发散，造成系统性的跟踪滞后。

sentences.en: We complement these upper bounds with minimax lower bounds under gradient-variation constraints, proving this momentum-induced tracking penalty is not an analytical artifact but an information-theoretic barrier: in drift-dominated regimes, momentum is unavoidably worse because stale-gradient averaging forces systematic lag.
sentences.zh: 我们在梯度变化约束下用极小极大下界补充这些上界，证明这种动量诱发的跟踪惩罚并非分析伪影，而是信息论障碍：在漂移主导的情形下，动量不可避免地更差，因为陈旧梯度平均强制产生系统性滞后。

sentences.en: Our results provide theoretical grounding for the empirical instability of momentum in dynamic settings and precisely delineate regime boundaries where vanilla SGD provably outperforms its accelerated counterparts.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果为动量在动态设置中的经验不稳定性提供了理论依据，并精确刻画了朴素SGD可证明优于其加速版本的情形的边界。

title_en: On the Relationship Between Activation Outliers and Feature Death in Sparse Autoencoders
title_zh: 论稀疏自编码器中激活异常值与特征死亡之间的关系

sentences.en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose neural network activations into interpretable features, but many learned features never activate, a problem called feature death that wastes dictionary capacity and can reintroduce superposition.
sentences.zh: 稀疏自编码器（SAEs）将神经网络激活分解成可解释的特征，但许多学得的特征从未激活，这一称为特征死亡的问题会浪费字典容量，并可能重新引入叠加。

sentences.en: Death rates vary dramatically between models: near-zero on GPT-2, over 70\% on AlphaFold3 with identical configurations.
sentences.zh: 不同模型间的死亡比率差异巨大：在GPT-2上近乎为零，而在配置相同的AlphaFold3上超过70\%。

sentences.en: We find that dimension-level activation outliers (dimensions whose mean magnitude is large relative to per-token variation) cause this by shifting pre-activations at initialization based on each feature's alignment with the activation mean.
sentences.zh: 我们发现维度级激活异常值（其平均幅度相对于逐词元变化较大的维度）会通过基于每个特征与激活均值的对齐情况在初始化时偏移预激活值，从而造成这一问题。

sentences.en: Features anti-aligned with the mean receive permanently negative pre-activations and never fire.
sentences.zh: 与均值反相（anti-aligned）对齐的特征会得到永久为负的预激活值，且从不触发。

sentences.en: We formalize outlier severity as $\gamma = \|\boldsymbol{\mu}\|/\|\boldsymbol{\sigma}\|$; it predicts initial death rates (Spearman $\rho = 0.89$ for dead-by-TopK, $0.82$ for dead-by-ReLU) across 454 model-layer combinations spanning language, vision, protein, and genomic models.
sentences.zh: 我们将异常值严重度形式化为 $\gamma = \|\boldsymbol{\mu}\|/\|\boldsymbol{\sigma}\|$；它在覆盖语言、视觉、蛋白质和基因组模型的454个模型-层组合上预测了初始死亡比率（按TopK判断死亡为Spearman $\rho = 0.89$，按ReLU判断死亡为 $0.82$）。

sentences.en: Dead features can revive during training, but recovery requires the SAE bias to learn the activation mean, a process that is prohibitively slow at high $\gamma$.
sentences.zh: 死亡特征在训练过程中可以复苏，但恢复需要SAE偏置学习激活均值，这一过程在 $\gamma$ 较高时极其缓慢。

sentences.en: Mean-centering (subtracting the activation mean) sidesteps this and eliminates outlier-induced death across all tested models, confirming the mechanism and providing a principled basis for when and why this preprocessing step is necessary.
sentences.zh: 均值中心化（减去激活均值）可绕开这一点，并在所有测试模型上消除了异常值诱发的死亡，证实了该机制，也为何时以及为何需要这一预处理步骤提供了有原则的依据。

title_en: On the Robustness of Langevin Dynamics to Score Function Error
title_zh: 论朗之万动力学对分数函数误差的鲁棒性

sentences.en: We consider the robustness of score-based generative modeling to errors in the estimate of the score function.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑基于分数的生成建模对分数函数估计误差的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: In particular, we show that Langevin dynamics is not robust to the $L^2$ errors (more generally $L^p$ errors) in the estimate of the score function.
sentences.zh: 特别地，我们表明朗之万动力学对分数函数估计中的 $L^2$ 误差（更一般地 $L^p$ 误差）并不鲁棒。

sentences.en: It is well-established that with small $L^2$ errors in the estimate of the score function, diffusion models can sample faithfully from the target distribution under fairly mild regularity assumptions in a polynomial time horizon.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，当分数函数估计存在较小 $L^2$ 误差时，扩散模型可以在相当温和的规律性假设下于多项式时间范围内忠实地从目标分布采样。

sentences.en: In contrast, our work shows that even for simple distributions in high dimensions, Langevin dynamics run for any polynomial time horizon will produce a distribution far from the target distribution in Total Variation (TV) distance, even when the $L^2$ error (more generally $L^p$) of the estimate of the score function is arbitrarily small.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，我们的工作表明，即使面对高维中的简单分布，只要朗之万动力学在任意多项式时间范围内运行，即使分数函数估计的 $L^2$ 误差（更一般地 $L^p$）任意小，其产生的分布也会在总变差（TV）距离上远离目标分布。

sentences.en: Considering such an error in the estimate of the score function is unavoidable in practice when learning the score function from data, our results provide further justification for diffusion models over Langevin dynamics and serve to caution against the use of Langevin dynamics with estimated scores.
sentences.zh: 考虑到在实践中从数据学习分数函数时，分数函数估计中的这种误差是不可避免的，我们的结果为扩散模型优于朗之万动力学提供了进一步依据，并警示人们慎用带估计分数的朗之万动力学。

title_en: On the Role of Batch Size in Stochastic Conditional Gradient Methods
title_zh: 论批大小在随机条件梯度方法中的作用

sentences.en: We study the role of batch size in stochastic conditional gradient methods under a $\mu$-Kurdyka–Łojasiewicz ($\mu$-KL) condition.
sentences.zh: 我们研究在 $μ$-Kurdyka–Łojasiewicz（$μ$-KL）条件下随机条件梯度方法中批大小的作用。

sentences.en: Focusing on momentum-based stochastic Frank–Wolfe–type conditional gradient algorithms (e.g., Scion), we derive a new analysis that explicitly captures the interaction between stepsize, batch size, and stochastic noise.
sentences.zh: 聚焦于基于动量的随机Frank–Wolfe型条件梯度算法（例如Scion），我们推导出一种新分析，显式捕捉步长、批大小和随机噪声之间的相互作用。

sentences.en: Our study reveals a regime-dependent behavior: increasing the batch size initially improves optimization accuracy, but beyond a critical threshold, the benefits saturate and can eventually degrade performance under a fixed token budget.
sentences.zh: 我们的研究揭示了一种随区间变化的行为：增大批大小最初会提升优化精度，但超过某个临界阈值后，其收益会饱和，在固定词元预算下最终可能使性能下降。

sentences.en: Notably, the theory predicts the magnitude of the optimal stepsize and aligns well with empirical practices observed in large-scale training.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，该理论预测了最优步长的量级，并与大规模训练中观察到的实践经验相符。

sentences.en: Leveraging these insights, we derive principled guidelines for selecting the batch size and stepsize, and propose an adaptive strategy that increases batch size and sequence length during training while preserving convergence guarantees.
sentences.zh: 利用这些洞见，我们推导出选择批大小和步长的有原则的准则，并提出一种自适应策略，在训练过程中增大批大小和序列长度，同时保持收敛保证。

sentences.en: Preliminary experiments are consistent with the theoretical predictions and illustrate the emergence of the predicted scaling regimes.
sentences.zh: 初步实验与理论预测一致，并展示了所预测缩放区间的出现。

sentences.en: Overall, our results provide a theoretical framework for understanding batch-size scaling in stochastic conditional gradient methods and offer guidance for designing efficient training schedules in large-scale optimization.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果为理解随机条件梯度方法中的批大小缩放提供了理论框架，并为设计大规模优化中的高效训练调度提供指导。

title_en: On the Role of Computation in Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 论计算量在强化学习中的作用

sentences.en: How does the amount of compute available to a reinforcement learning (RL) policy affect its learning?
sentences.zh: 强化学习（RL）策略可用的计算量如何影响其学习？

sentences.en: Can policies using a fixed amount of parameters, still benefit from additional compute?
sentences.zh: 使用固定参数量的策略能否仍从额外的计算中受益？

sentences.en: The standard RL framework does not provide a language to answer these questions formally.
sentences.zh: 标准RL框架并未提供形式化回答这些问题的语言。

sentences.en: Empirically, deep RL policies are often parameterized as neural networks with static architectures, conflating the amount of compute and the number of parameters.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，深度RL策略通常被参数化为具有静态架构的神经网络，从而混淆了计算量与参数数量。

sentences.en: In this paper, we formalize compute bounded policies and prove that policies which use more compute can solve problems and generalize to longer-horizon tasks that are outside the scope of policies with less compute.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们形式化了计算有界策略，并证明使用更多计算的策略能够解决超出计算量较少策略能力范围的问题，并泛化到更长时域的任务。

sentences.en: Building on prior work in algorithmic learning and model-free planning, we propose a minimal architecture that can use a variable amount of compute.
sentences.zh: 基于算法学习和无模型规划方面的先前工作，我们提出一种可以使用可变计算量的最小架构。

sentences.en: Our experiments complement our theory.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验补充了我们的理论。

sentences.en: On a set 31 different tasks spanning online and offline RL, we show that $(1)$ this architecture achieves stronger performance simply by using more compute, and $(2)$ stronger generalization on longer-horizon test tasks compared to standard feedforward networks or deep residual network using upto 5 times more parameters.
sentences.zh: 在涵盖在线和离线RL的31个不同任务上，我们表明（1）该架构仅通过使用更多计算就实现了更强的性能，并且（2）与使用多达5倍参数的标准前馈网络或深度残差网络相比，在更长时域的测试任务上具有更强的泛化。

title_en: On the Salience of Low-Probability Tokens for AI-Generated Text Detection: A Multiscale Uncertainty Perspective
title_zh: 论低概率词元对AI生成文本检测的显著性：一种多尺度不确定性视角

sentences.en: AI-generated text increasingly blends with human writing, raising practical risks such as misinformation, academic misuse, and corpora contamination.
sentences.zh: AI生成的文本日益与人类写作混溶，带来诸如虚假信息、学术滥用和语料污染等实际风险。

sentences.en: While statistical detectors are appealing for efficiency and generalization, they suffer from two key limitations.
sentences.zh: 虽然统计检测器在效率和泛化方面颇具吸引力，但它们存在两个关键局限。

sentences.en: (i) Boilerplate dominance, boilerplate tokens shared across human and LLM writing can overwhelm discriminative signals.
sentences.zh: （i）样板文本主导：人类和LLM写作共有的样板词元可能淹没判别性信号。

sentences.en: (ii) Brittle point estimates, relying on a single probability score yields unstable decisions under adversarial manipulations.
sentences.zh: （ii）脆弱的点估计：依赖单一概率分数在对抗性操纵下会产生不稳定的决策。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose $\textbf{Uncertainty}$, a multiscale uncertainty estimator that focuses on informative low-probability tokens, which more clearly expose distributional discrepancies.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出$\textbf{Uncertainty}$，一种多尺度不确定性估计器，聚焦于信息量大的低概率词元，它们能更清晰地暴露分布差异。

sentences.en: Locally, it alleviates boilerplate dominance by averaging the log-probabilities of low-probability tokens; globally, it reduces brittleness by capturing the distributional shape of this low-probability region via Rényi entropy.
sentences.zh: 在局部，它通过对低概率词元的对数概率取平均来缓解样板文本主导；在全局，它通过Rényi熵捕捉这一低概率区域的分布形状来降低脆弱性。

sentences.en: We further extend the detector to $\textbf{Uncertainty++}$ via conditional independent sampling, yielding a more stable uncertainty estimation.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步通过条件独立采样将检测器扩展到$\textbf{Uncertainty++}$，产生更稳定的不确定性估计。

sentences.en: Experiments across seven datasets and sixteen LLMs demonstrate high effectiveness, generalization, and robustness.
sentences.zh: 在七个数据集和十六个LLM上的实验展示了高效率、泛化性和鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Our code is available at github.com/guoyikai2000/Uncertainty-AIGT.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 github.com/guoyikai2000/Uncertainty-AIGT 获取。

title_en: On the Sample Efficiency of Inverse Dynamics Models for Semi-Supervised Imitation Learning
title_zh: 论半监督模仿学习中逆动力学模型的样本效率

sentences.en: Semi-supervised imitation learning (SSIL) consists in learning a policy from a small dataset of action-labeled trajectories and a much larger dataset of action-free trajectories.
sentences.zh: 半监督模仿学习（SSIL）即从少量带动作标签的轨迹数据集和更大的无动作轨迹数据集中学习策略。

sentences.en: Some SSIL methods learn an inverse dynamics model (IDM) to predict the action from the current state and the next state.
sentences.zh: 一些SSIL方法学习一个逆动力学模型（IDM），从当前状态和下一状态预测动作。

sentences.en: An IDM can act as a policy when paired with a video model (VM-IDM) or as a label generator to perform behavior cloning on action-free data (IDM labeling).
sentences.zh: IDM与视频模型搭配时可以充当策略（VM-IDM），或者作为标签生成器对无动作数据执行行为克隆（IDM标记）。

sentences.en: In this work, we first show that VM-IDM and IDM labeling learn the same policy in a limit case, which we call the IDM-based policy.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们首先表明在极限情形下VM-IDM和IDM标记学习相同的策略，我们称之为基于IDM的策略。

sentences.en: We then argue that the previously observed advantage of IDM-based policies over behavior cloning is due to the superior sample efficiency of IDM learning, which we attribute to two causes: (i) the ground-truth IDM tends to be contained in a lower complexity hypothesis class relative to the expert policy, and (ii) the ground-truth IDM is often less stochastic than the expert policy.
sentences.zh: 然后我们论证，先前观察到的基于IDM的策略相对于行为克隆的优势源于IDM学习优越的样本效率，我们将其归因于两个原因：（i）真实IDM往往包含在相对专家策略复杂度假设类更低的类别中，并且（ii）真实IDM通常比专家策略的随机性更小。

sentences.en: We argue these claims based on insights from statistical learning theory and novel experiments, including a study of IDM-based policies using recent architectures for unified video-action prediction (UVA).
sentences.zh: 我们基于统计学习理论的洞见和新颖实验来论证这些主张，包括使用近期统一视频-动作预测（UVA）架构研究基于IDM的策略。

sentences.en: Motivated by these insights, we finally propose an improved version of the existing LAPO algorithm for latent action policy learning.
sentences.zh: 受这些洞见启发，我们最后提出了现有LAPO潜动作策略学习算法的一个改进版本。

sentences.en: We experiment on the Procgen, Push-T and LIBERO benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们在Procgen、Push-T和LIBERO基准上进行实验。

title_en: On the Separability of Information in Diffusion Models
title_zh: 论扩散模型中信息的可分离性

sentences.en: Diffusion models transform noise into data by injecting information that was captured in their neural network during the training phase.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型通过在训练阶段捕获在其神经网络中的信息注入噪声来将噪声转化为数据。

sentences.en: In this paper we ask: what is this information?
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们问：这种信息是什么？

sentences.en: We find that, in pixel-space diffusion models, (1) a large fraction of the total information in the neural network is committed to reconstructing small-scale perceptual details of the image, and (2) the correlations between images and their class labels are informed by the semantic content of the images, and are largely agnostic to the low-level details.
sentences.zh: 我们发现在像素空间扩散模型中，（1）神经网络中总信息的很大一部分被用于重建图像的小尺度感知细节，并且（2）图像与其类标签之间的相关性受图像语义内容的引导，并且在很大程度上与小尺度细节无关。

sentences.en: We argue that these properties are intrinsically tied to the manifold structure of the data itself.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这些性质与数据自身的流形结构有内在联系。

sentences.en: Finally, we show that these facts explain the efficacy of classifier-free guidance: the guidance vector amplifies the mutual information between images and conditioning signals early in the generative process, influencing semantic structure, but tapers out as perceptual details are filled in.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们表明这些事实解释了无分类器引导的有效性：引导向量在生成过程早期放大图像与条件信号之间的互信息，影响语义结构，但随着感知细节被填充而逐渐减弱。

title_en: On the Sharp Input-Output Analysis of Nonlinear Systems under Adversarial Attacks
title_zh: 论对抗攻击下非线性系统的尖锐输入输出分析

sentences.en: This paper is concerned with learning the input-output mapping of general nonlinear dynamical systems.
sentences.zh: 本文关注学习一般非线性动力学系统的输入输出映射。

sentences.en: While the existing literature focuses on Gaussian inputs and benign disturbances, we significantly broaden the scope of admissible control inputs and allow correlated, nonzero-mean, adversarial disturbances.
sentences.zh: 虽然现有文献聚焦于高斯输入和良性扰动，我们将可容许控制输入的范畴显著拓宽，并允许相关的、非零均值的对抗性扰动。

sentences.en: With our reformulation as a linear combination of basis functions, we prove that the $\ell_2$-norm estimator overcomes the challenges posed by an adversary with access to the full information history, provided that the attack times are sparse, *i.e.*, the probability that the system is under adversarial attack at a given time is smaller than a certain threshold.
sentences.zh: 借助我们将其重构为基函数线性组合的方式，我们证明只要攻击时间是稀疏的，*即*系统在给定时刻处于对抗攻击下的概率小于某个阈值，$\ell_2$-范数估计器就能克服能访问完整信息历史的对抗者的挑战。

sentences.en: We provide an estimation error bound that decays with the input memory length and prove its optimality by constructing a problem instance that suffers from the same bound under probabilistic adversarial attacks.
sentences.zh: 我们给出了随输入记忆长度衰减的估计误差界，并通过构造一个在概率对抗攻击下遭受相同界的实例来证明其最优性。

sentences.en: Our work provides a sharp input-output analysis for a generic nonlinear and partially observed system under significantly generalized assumptions compared to existing works.
sentences.zh: 与现有工作相比，我们的工作在显著推广的假设下，为一般非线性且部分可观测的系统提供了尖锐的输入输出分析。

title_en: On the Spectral Unreachability of Brain Graph Learning
title_zh: 论脑图学习中的谱不可达性

sentences.en: Brain network classification is pivotal for diagnosing neurological disorders, yet identifying interpretable functional biomarkers fundamentally relies on precise parcellation.
sentences.zh: 脑网络分类对诊断神经系统疾病至关重要，然而识别可解释的功能生物标志从根本上依赖于精确的分区。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, conventional deep graph encoders applied to brain networks suffer from a critical theoretical limitation termed Spectral Unreachability.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，应用于脑网络的传统深度图编码器遭受一个称为谱不可达性的关键理论局限。

sentences.en: Through graph spectral analysis, this paper demonstrates that standard coupled encoder-pooling architectures inevitably oversmooth node representations, corrupting the high-frequency topological signals strictly required to delineate sharp module boundaries.
sentences.zh: 通过图谱分析，本文表明标准的耦合编码器-池化架构不可避免地会过度平滑节点表示，破坏严格需要用于描绘锐利模块边界的高频拓扑信号。

sentences.en: To provide a structural remedy, the Hierarchical Spectral Parcellation Network (HiSP-Net) is proposed, which structurally decouples partition learning from feature smoothing via a project-then-align paradigm.
sentences.zh: 为提供结构性补救，我们提出了层级谱分区网络（HiSP-Net），它通过先投影后对齐的范式在结构上将分区学习与特征平滑解耦。

sentences.en: Specifically, HiSP-Net maps representations directly into a partition space using a topology-agnostic projection block to preserve all-frequency details, while a Topology-Aware Alignment regularizer subsequently enforces spatial coherence.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，HiSP-Net使用与拓扑无关的投影块将表示直接映射到分区空间以保留全频细节，随后由拓扑感知对齐正则化器强制实现空间一致性。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations demonstrate that HiSP-Net consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in classification, while successfully extracting stable and structurally coherent functional biomarkers.
sentences.zh: 大量评估表明，HiSP-Net在分类上一致地优于最先进的基线，同时成功提取出稳定且结构连贯的功能生物标志。

sentences.en: Source code is available at https://github.com/Kevin-916/HiSP-Net-demo/.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在 https://github.com/Kevin-916/HiSP-Net-demo/ 获取。

title_en: On the Theoretical Limitations of Embedding-based Link Prediction
title_zh: 论基于嵌入的链路预测的理论局限

sentences.en: Neural networks often map low-dimensional embeddings to high-dimensional output spaces.
sentences.zh: 神经网络常常将低维嵌入映射到高维输出空间。

sentences.en: Usually, the output layer is linear, which can create a *rank bottleneck* that limits the functions a model can represent.
sentences.zh: 通常，输出层是线性的，这可能产生一个限制模型所能表示函数的*秩瓶颈*。

sentences.en: Such bottlenecks are ubiquitous in link prediction models, such as knowledge graph embeddings (KGEs), as the output space of entities can be orders of magnitude larger than the embedding dimension.
sentences.zh: 这种瓶颈在链路预测模型中普遍存在，例如知识图谱嵌入（KGEs），因为实体的输出空间可能比嵌入维度大若干数量级。

sentences.en: We investigate how rank bottlenecks limit model expressivity for fitting the training data.
sentences.zh: 我们研究秩瓶颈如何限制模型在拟合训练数据上的表达性。

sentences.en: While previous work focused on sufficient bounds on the embedding dimension required for specific KGEs, we show necessary bounds for *all* KGEs with a linear output layer, which grow with graph size and connectivity.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前工作聚焦于特定KGE所需嵌入维度的充分界，我们给出了所有带线性输出层的KGE的必然界，这些界随图的大小和连通性增长。

sentences.en: We also consider a non-linear output layer using mixtures to break the bottleneck without significant parameter overhead.
sentences.zh: 我们还考虑使用混合的非线性输出层，以在无明显参数开销的情况下打破瓶颈。

sentences.en: Empirically, we show that models using this non-linear layer improve in ranking performance and probabilistic fit for large and dense datasets at a low parameter cost, as predicted by our theory.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，我们表明使用这种非线性层的模型在大型稠密数据集上以较低的参数成本提升了排序性能和概率拟合，这与我们的理论预测一致。

sentences.en: Our work reveals how linear output layers limit KGEs and motivates non-linear alternatives for scaling to large and dense graphs.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作揭示了线性输出层如何限制KGE，并激励非线性替代方案以扩展到大型稠密图。

title_en: On the Theory of Continual Learning with Gradient Descent for Neural Networks
title_zh: 论神经网络基于梯度下降的持续学习理论

sentences.en: Continual learning, the ability of a model to adapt to an ongoing sequence of tasks without forgetting earlier ones, is a central goal of artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 持续学习，即模型在不遗忘先前任务的情况下适应不断到来的任务序列的能力，是人工智能的核心目标。

sentences.en: To better understand its underlying mechanisms, we study the limitations of continual learning in a tractable yet representative setting.
sentences.zh: 为更好地理解其底层机制，我们在一个易处理但具有代表性的设定中研究持续学习的局限。

sentences.en: Specifically, we analyze one-hidden-layer quadratic neural networks trained by gradient descent on a sequence of XOR-cluster datasets with Gaussian noise, where different tasks correspond to clusters with orthogonal means.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们分析由梯度下降在一系列带高斯噪声的XOR簇数据集上训练的单隐层二次神经网络，其中不同任务对应于正交均值的簇。

sentences.en: Our analysis is based on a tight characterization of gradient descent dynamics for the training loss, which yields explicit bounds on the rate of train-time forgetting as functions of the number of iterations, sample size, number of tasks, and hidden-layer width.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析基于训练损失梯度下降动力学的紧致刻画，由此得到训练时遗忘速率作为迭代次数、样本量、任务数和隐层宽度函数的显式界。

sentences.en: We then leverage an algorithmic stability framework to bound the generalization gap, leading to corresponding guarantees on test-time forgetting.
sentences.zh: 然后我们利用算法稳定性框架来界定泛化差距，从而得到测试时遗忘的相应保证。

sentences.en: Together, our results provide the first closed-form  guarantees for forgetting in continual learning with neural networks and show how key problem parameters jointly govern forgetting dynamics.
sentences.zh: 这些结果共同提供了神经网络持续学习中遗忘的首次闭式保证，并展示了关键问题参数如何共同支配遗忘动力学。

sentences.en: Numerical experiments corroborate our theoretical results.
sentences.zh: 数值实验证实了我们的理论结果。

title_en: On the Variability of Concept Activation Vectors
title_zh: 论概念激活向量的变异性

sentences.en: One of the most pressing challenges in artificial intelligence is to make models more transparent to their users.
sentences.zh: 人工智能最紧迫的挑战之一是让模型对用户更加透明。

sentences.en: Recently, explainable artificial intelligence has come up with numerous methods to tackle this challenge.
sentences.zh: 近来，可解释人工智能提出了众多方法来解决这一挑战。

sentences.en: A promising avenue is to use concept-based explanations, that is, high-level concepts instead of plain feature importance scores.
sentences.zh: 一个有前景的方向是使用基于概念的解释，即使用高层概念而非单纯的特征重要性分数。

sentences.en: Among this class of methods, Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs, Kim et al., 2018) stand out as one of the main protagonists.
sentences.zh: 在这一类方法中，概念激活向量（CAVs，Kim et al., 2018）是主要代表之一。

sentences.en: One interesting aspect of CAVs is that their computation requires sampling random examples from the train set.
sentences.zh: CAV的一个有趣方面是，其计算需要从训练集中采样随机示例。

sentences.en: Therefore, the actual vectors obtained may vary depending on the randomness of this sampling.
sentences.zh: 因此，实际得到的向量可能随这种采样的随机性而变化。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a fine-grained theoretical analysis of CAV construction in order to quantify their variability.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出对CAV构建的细粒度理论分析，以量化其变异性。

sentences.en: Our results, confirmed by experiments on several real-life datasets of four different modalities, point to an universal result: the variance of CAVs declines roughly as $1/N$, where $N$ is the number of random examples.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果（在四个不同模态的多个真实数据集上的实验证实）指向一个普适结论：CAV的方差大致随 $1/N$ 下降，其中 $N$ 是随机示例的数量。

sentences.en: Based on this, we give practical recommendations for a resource-efficient application of the method.
sentences.zh: 基于此，我们为该方法在资源有限条件下的高效应用给出了实用建议。

title_en: On Training Large Language Models for Long-Horizon Tasks: An Empirical Study of Horizon Length
title_zh: 论为长时域任务训练大语言模型：关于时域长度的实证研究

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise as interactive agents that solve tasks through extended sequences of environment interactions.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）已展现出作为交互式智能体的前景，它们通过与环境交互的扩展序列来求解任务。

sentences.en: While prior work has primarily focused on system-level optimizations or algorithmic improvements, the role of task horizon length in shaping training dynamics remains poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前工作主要聚焦于系统级优化或算法改进，但任务时域长度在塑造训练动力学中的作用仍远未被理解。

sentences.en: In this work, we present a systematic empirical study that examines horizon length through controlled task constructions.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们通过受控任务构造呈现了一项系统性的实证研究，考察时域长度。

sentences.en: Specifically, we construct controlled tasks in which agents face identical decision rules and reasoning structures, but differ only in the length of action sequences required for successful completion.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们构造受控任务，其中智能体面对相同的决策规则和推理结构，仅在成功完成所需的动作序列长度上有所不同。

sentences.en: Our results reveal that increasing horizon length alone constitutes a training bottleneck, inducing severe training instability driven by exploration difficulties and credit assignment challenges.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果揭示，单独增加时域长度本身就构成训练瓶颈，会因探索困难和信用分配挑战而引发严重的训练不稳定性。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that horizon reduction is a key principle to address this limitation, stabilizing training and achieving better performance in long-horizon tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们证明时域缩减是解决这一局限的关键原则，能够稳定训练并在长时域任务上取得更好的性能。

sentences.en: Moreover, we find that horizon reduction is related to stronger generalization across horizon lengths: models trained under reduced horizons generalize more effectively to longer-horizon variants at inference time, a phenomenon we refer to as horizon generalization.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们发现时域缩减与跨时域长度更强的泛化相关：在缩减时域下训练的模型在推理时能更有效地泛化到更长时域变体，我们将这一现象称为时域泛化。

title_en: On Uniform Error Bounds for Kernel Regression under Non-Gaussian Noise
title_zh: 论非高斯噪声下核回归的一致误差界

sentences.en: Providing non-conservative uncertainty quantification for function estimates derived from noisy observations remains a fundamental challenge in statistical machine learning, particularly for applications in safety-critical domains.
sentences.zh: 为从含噪观测推导出的函数估计提供不过度保守的不确定性量化，仍是统计机器学习中的一个根本性挑战，尤其是在安全关键领域的应用中。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose novel non-asymptotic probabilistic uniform error bounds for kernel-based regression.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们为基于核的回归提出了新颖的非渐近概率一致误差界。

sentences.en: Compared to related bounds in the literature that are restricted to (conditionally) independent sub-Gaussian noise, our bounds allow to consider a broad class of non-Gaussian distributions, such as sub-Gaussian, bounded, sub-exponential, and variance/moment-bounded noise.
sentences.zh: 与文献中仅限于（条件）独立次高斯噪声的相关界相比，我们的界允许考虑一大类非高斯分布，如次高斯、有界、次指数和方差/矩有界噪声。

sentences.en: Moreover, our results apply to correlated and uncorrelated noise.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的结果适用于相关和不相关的噪声。

sentences.en: We compare our proposed error bounds with existing results in terms of the induced uncertainty region and their performance in safe control, demonstrating the tightness of the proposed bounds.
sentences.zh: 我们从诱导的不确定性区域及其在安全控制中的表现两方面，将我们提出的误差界与现有结果进行比较，展示了所提界的紧致性。

topic: General Machine Learning->Sequential, Network, and Time Series Modeling
title_en: Once-for-All: Scalable Simultaneous Forecasting via Equilibrium State Estimation
title_zh: 一次性完成：通过均衡状态估计实现可扩展的同步预测

sentences.en: We introduce Equilibrium State Estimation (ESE), a novel paradigm for simultaneous prediction, where multiple interacting systems require separate yet coordinated forecasts.
sentences.zh: 我们引入均衡状态估计（ESE），一种同时预测的新范式，其中多个相互作用的系统需要各自独立却又协调一致的预测。

sentences.en: Such scenarios often arise in real-world such as economics and healthcare modeling.
sentences.zh: 这类场景常出现在经济学和医疗建模等现实应用中。

sentences.en: Unlike existing approaches that predict one system at a time, ESE forecasts all systems in a single pass.
sentences.zh: 与一次只预测一个系统的现有方法不同，ESE在单次前向过程中预测所有系统。

sentences.en: It first estimates the equilibrium state across systems, then generates holistic forecasts based on the difference between the current state and the estimated equilibrium.
sentences.zh: 它首先估计跨系统的均衡状态，然后基于当前状态与估计均衡之间的差异生成整体预测。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets, including currency exchange and COVID-19 spread modeling, demonstrate that ESE is at least as accurate as state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods while being significantly faster.
sentences.zh: 在包括货币汇率和COVID-19传播建模在内的合成数据集和真实数据集上的大量实验表明，ESE的准确度至少与最先进（SOTA）方法相当，同时显著更快。

sentences.en: In addition, ESE integrates seamlessly with conventional predictors, combining their accuracy with its exceptional efficiency and delivering a 10–70× speedup.
sentences.zh: 此外，ESE能与传统预测器无缝集成，将其准确度与自身卓越的效率相结合，实现10–70倍的加速。

sentences.en: With linear-time complexity, ESE scales far better than SOTA methods as the number of systems increases.
sentences.zh: 凭借线性时间复杂度，随着系统数量的增加，ESE的扩展性远优于SOTA方法。

sentences.en: Moreover, it remains accurate under diverse perturbations, establishing ESE as a fast, generalizable, robust, and scalable multi-prediction method.
sentences.zh: 此外，它在多种扰动下仍保持准确，使ESE成为一种快速、可泛化、鲁棒且可扩展的多预测方法。

title_en: One Batch Is Enough: A Unified Dataset Condensation Framework for General Time Series Analysis
title_zh: 一个批次足矣：面向通用时间序列分析的统一数据集凝聚框架

sentences.en: Time-series analysis is critical in real-world applications, yet the explosion of time-series data imposes severe burdens on storage and computational resources.
sentences.zh: 时间序列分析在现实应用中至关重要，然而时间序列数据的爆炸式增长给存储和计算资源带来了沉重负担。

sentences.en: Recently, dataset condensation has emerged as a promising data-centric solution by synthesizing compact yet informative datasets to replace large-scale raw data.
sentences.zh: 近年来，数据集凝聚作为一种有前景的数据中心化解决方案出现，通过合成紧凑而信息丰富的数据集来替代大规模原始数据。

sentences.en: However, existing methods are largely vision-centric, failing to capture unique temporal properties of time series, or task-specific, tightly coupling the condensed data to a particular downstream objective.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法大多以视觉为中心，未能捕捉时间序列独特的时域特性；或者以任务为中心，将凝聚数据与特定下游目标紧密耦合。

sentences.en: As a result, these approaches suffer from feature mismatch and fail to generalize across diverse time-series tasks.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些方法遭受特征错配，并且无法在多样的时间序列任务间泛化。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose UniTSC, the first unified dataset condensation framework for general time-series analysis.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们提出UniTSC，面向通用时间序列分析的首个统一数据集凝聚框架。

sentences.en: UniTSC employs a multi-view hybrid encoder to capture task-invariant representations across temporal, spectral, and topological perspectives.
sentences.zh: UniTSC采用多视角混合编码器，从时域、频域和拓扑视角捕捉任务不变表示。

sentences.en: Building upon this representation, we design a tri-space alignment paradigm that jointly aligns optimization trajectories, power spectral densities, and multivariate dependency structures, enabling comprehensive information preservation under extreme compression.
sentences.zh: 在此表示的基础上，我们设计了一种三空间对齐范式，联合对齐优化轨迹、功率谱密度和多变量依赖结构，从而在极端压缩下实现全面的信息保持。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that UniTSC retains up to 97.9\% of downstream performance using as little as 0.01\% of the original training data, within our experimental settings tied to standard sequence lengths, revealing that a single batch-equivalent budget ($\textless$ 128 samples) is sufficient to capture the essential dynamics of complex time-series data.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，在与标准序列长度相关的实验设定下，UniTSC仅用原始训练数据的0.01\% 就能保留高达97.9\% 的下游性能，揭示出单个批次当量预算（$\textless$ 128个样本）就足以捕捉复杂时间序列数据的基本动力学。

title_en: One Bias After Another: Mechanistic Reward Shaping and Persistent Biases in Language Reward Models
title_zh: 一个接一个的偏见：语言奖励模型中的机制性奖励塑造与持续性偏见

sentences.en: Reward Models (RMs) are crucial for online alignment of language models (LMs) with human preferences.
sentences.zh: 奖励模型（RMs）对于在线对齐语言模型（LMs）与人类偏好至关重要。

sentences.en: However, RM-based preference-tuning is vulnerable to \textit{reward hacking}, whereby LM policies learn undesirable behaviors from flawed RMs.
sentences.zh: 然而，基于RM的偏好调优容易受到\textit{奖励黑客}的影响，LM策略会从有缺陷的RM中习得不良行为。

sentences.en: By systematically measuring biases in five high-quality RMs, including the state-of-the-art, we find that issues persist despite prior work with respect to length, sycophancy, and overconfidence.
sentences.zh: 通过系统性地度量五个高质量RM（包括最先进的）中的偏见，我们发现尽管先前工作已就长度、谄媚和过度自信等方面进行了处理，这些问题仍然存在。

sentences.en: We also discover new issues related to bias toward model-specific “styles” and answer-order.
sentences.zh: 我们还发现了与模型特有“风格”和答案顺序偏置相关的新问题。

sentences.en: We categorize RM failures as tractable or resistant to linear intervention and propose a simple post-hoc intervention to mitigate low-complexity biases that arise from spurious correlations.
sentences.zh: 我们将RM失效分类为可处理类或对线性干预鲁棒类，并提出一种简单的后验干预，以缓解由虚假相关产生的小复杂度偏见。

sentences.en: Our proposed \textbf{mechanistic reward shaping} reduces targeted biases without degrading reward quality and while using minimal labeled data.
sentences.zh: 我们提出的\textbf{机制性奖励塑造}在不降低奖励质量且使用最少标注数据的情况下减少了特定偏见。

sentences.en: The method is extensible to new biases, model-internal, and generalizes out-of-distribution.
sentences.zh: 该方法可扩展到新的偏见，对模型内部有效，并能泛化到分布外。

title_en: One Bug, Hundreds Behind: LLMs for Large-Scale Bug Discovery
title_zh: 一个缺陷，数百项目落后：用于大规模缺陷发现的大语言模型

sentences.en: Recurring Pattern Bugs (RPBs) are defined as bugs where a single root cause appears repeatedly across multiple code segments.
sentences.zh: 重复模式缺陷（RPBs）被定义为单个根因在多个代码段中反复出现的缺陷。

sentences.en: These bugs remain a persistent security threat even after individual instances are patched.
sentences.zh: 即便在补丁分别修复了各个实例之后，这些缺陷仍是持续的安全威胁。

sentences.en: Various static analyzers exist for finding specific bug patterns but require significant engineering effort and fail to generalize well beyond their predefined template, preventing them from detecting RPBs.
sentences.zh: 存在各种静态分析器可用于发现特定缺陷模式，但它们需要大量工程投入，且难以超出其预定义模板进行泛化，从而无法检测RPBs。

sentences.en: To tackle RPBs, we introduce BugStone, a hybrid framework combining LLVM-based program analysis with Large Language Models to automate RPB detection.
sentences.zh: 为应对RPBs，我们引入BugStone，一个结合基于LLVM的程序分析与大语言模型的混合框架，以自动化RPB检测。

sentences.en: BugStone leverages a single patched instance to synthesize abstract error patterns and retrieves semantically similar bugs throughout the codebase.
sentences.zh: BugStone利用单个已修补实例来合成抽象错误模式，并在整个代码库中检索语义相似的缺陷。

sentences.en: To evaluate BugStone,  we create a ground truth dataset by analyzing over 1.9K security bugs reports,  on which BugStone achieves 92.2% precision and 79.1% pairwise accuracy.
sentences.zh: 为评估BugStone，我们通过分析超过1.9K份安全缺陷报告构建了一个真值数据集，BugStone在其上取得了92.2%的精确率和79.1%的成对准确率。

sentences.en: We further validated BugStone through a large-scale real-world deployment.
sentences.zh: 我们还通过大规模真实世界部署进一步验证了BugStone。

sentences.en: In the Linux kernel, BugStone identified over 22K potential issues; a manual audit of 400 samples confirmed 246 valid bugs, including invalid pointer dereferences, resource leaks, type errors, performance issues, and others.
sentences.zh: 在Linux内核中，BugStone识别出超过22K个潜在问题；对400个样本的人工审计确认了246个有效缺陷，包括无效指针解引用、资源泄漏、类型错误、性能问题等。

sentences.en: To evaluate the generalizability of BugStone, we further applied it to the top 100 Python projects, discovering multiple critical command injection vulnerabilities.
sentences.zh: 为评估BugStone的泛化性，我们进一步将其应用于前100个Python项目，发现了多个关键的命令注入漏洞。

topic: General Machine Learning->Unsupervised and Semi-supervised Learning
title_en: One Coin Has Two Sides: Single Poistive Multi Label Learning from Salient Annotations
title_zh: 一枚硬币有两面：基于显著标注的单正例多标签学习

sentences.en: Single-Positive Multi-Label Learning (SPML) studies learning from incomplete supervision, where each instance is annotated with only one positive label despite potentially belonging to multiple categories.
sentences.zh: 单正例多标签学习（SPML）研究从不完整监督中学习的问题，其中每个实例尽管可能属于多个类别，却仅被标注一个正标签。

sentences.en: While existing methods assume the annotated labels are randomly distributed, real-world annotations are often biased toward the most salient category.
sentences.zh: 虽然现有方法假设标注标签随机分布，但现实世界的标注往往偏向最显著的类别。

sentences.en: We formalize this realistic scenario as Salient Single-Positive Multi-Label Learning (SalSPML).
sentences.zh: 我们将这一现实场景形式化为显著单正例多标签学习（SalSPML）。

sentences.en: This salient annotation bias poses a challenge to conventional SPML methods,  as the missing labels often correspond to less salient and harder-to-recognize categories.
sentences.zh: 这种显著标注偏差对传统SPML方法构成挑战，因为缺失的标签往往对应不显著且更难识别的类别。

sentences.en: Fortunately, we find that salient annotations are typically more representative and informative.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，我们发现显著标注通常更具代表性和信息量。

sentences.en: Motivated by this insight, we propose Prototype-Guided Rejection for Salient Annotation (PiSA),  which constructs reliable class-wise prototypes from salient labels and leverages them to guide embedding learning for non-salient labels recognition.
sentences.zh: 受此洞见启发，我们提出面向显著标注的原型引导拒绝（PiSA），从显著标签构建可靠的类级原型，并利用它们来指导非显著标签识别的嵌入学习。

sentences.en: We theoretically demonstrate that SalSPML is harder than Random SPML due to irreducible annotation bias, and under SalSPML, more accurate prototypes facilitate false-negative label detection.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上表明，由于不可约的标注偏差，SalSPML比随机SPML更难；而在SalSPML下，更准确的原型有助于假阴性标签检测。

sentences.en: Experiments on multiple benchmarks, together with two newly constructed real-world SalSPML datasets, demonstrate that PiSA consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving an average mAP improvement of 3.16\%.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准以及两个新构建的真实世界SalSPML数据集上的实验表明，PiSA一致地优于现有方法，平均mAP提升3.16\%。

title_en: One Intervention per Component is Enough: Towards Identifiability in Linear Stochastic Dynamics from Steady State
title_zh: 每个组件一次干预便足够：从稳态实现线性随机动力学的可识别性

sentences.en: We study the problem of recovering the parameters of a multivariate Ornstein–Uhlenbeck (OU) process from steady-state observational and interventional data.
sentences.zh: 我们研究从稳态观测和干预数据中恢复多元Ornstein–Uhlenbeck（OU）过程参数的问题。

sentences.en: In many applications, such as large-scale gene perturbation experiments, only stationary “snapshot” measurements are available, making standard stochastic differential equation estimation methods that rely on time-series trajectories inapplicable.
sentences.zh: 在许多应用中，例如大规模基因扰动实验，只有平稳的“快照”测量可用，这使得依赖时间序列轨迹的标准随机微分方程估计方法不再适用。

sentences.en: We first establish an identifiability result: one intervention per strongly connected component (SCC) of the drift graph suffices to recover all OU process parameters generically up to a global scaling factor.
sentences.zh: 我们首先建立了一个可识别性结果：对漂移图的每个强连通分量（SCC）进行一次干预，就足以在通常情形下恢复所有OU过程参数，直至一个全局缩放因子。

sentences.en: This holds provided that the SCC condensation graph is connected with a single root and certain spectral nondegeneracy assumptions hold.
sentences.zh: 这要求在SCC凝聚图连通且具有单一根节点，并且满足一定的谱非退化假设。

sentences.en: We propose a recursive learning algorithm that orders SCCs topologically and, for each component, isolates its marginal dynamics and solves a linear system derived from the steady-state moment equations, leveraging parameters recovered for upstream components.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种递归学习算法，对SCC进行拓扑排序，并对每个分量分离其边际动力学，利用为上游分量恢复的参数，求解由稳态矩方程导出的线性系统。

sentences.en: Building on this theoretical foundation, we propose a regularized least-squares estimator that jointly minimizes residuals of the steady-state mean and covariance equations across observational and interventional data.
sentences.zh: 在这一理论基础上，我们提出一种正则化最小二乘估计器，联合最小化观测和干预数据上稳态均值与协方差方程的残差。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in recovering parameters and predicting unseen interventions.
sentences.zh: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验证明了我们的方法在恢复参数和预测未见干预方面的有效性。

title_en: One LR Doesn’t Fit All: Heavy-Tail Guided Layerwise Learning Rates for LLMs
title_zh: 一个学习率不适配一切：面向LLM的重尾引导的逐层学习率

sentences.en: Learning rate configuration is a fundamental aspect of modern deep learning.
sentences.zh: 学习率配置是现代深度学习的一个基本方面。

sentences.en: The prevailing practice of applying a uniform learning rate across all layers overlooks the structural heterogeneity of Transformers, potentially limiting their effectiveness as the backbone of Large Language Models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 对所有层施加统一学习率的通行做法忽视了Transformer的结构异质性，可能限制它们作为大语言模型（LLMs）骨干的有效性。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce Layerwise Learning Rate (LLR), an adaptive scheme that assigns distinct learning rates to individual Transformer layers.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入逐层学习率（LLR），一种为各个Transformer层分配不同学习率的自适应方案。

sentences.en: Our method is grounded in Heavy-Tailed Self-Regularization (HT-SR) theory, which characterizes the empirical spectral density (ESD) of weight correlation matrices to quantify heavy-tailedness.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法基于重尾自正则化（HT-SR）理论，该理论刻画权重相关矩阵的经验谱密度（ESD）以量化重尾程度。

sentences.en: Layers with weaker heavy-tailedness are assigned larger learning rates to accelerate their training, while layers with stronger heavy-tailedness receive smaller learning rates.
sentences.zh: 重尾较弱的层被分配更大的学习率以加速其训练，而重尾较强的层则获得更小的学习率。

sentences.en: By tailoring learning rates in this manner, LLR promotes balanced training across layers, leading to faster convergence and improved generalization.
sentences.zh: 通过以这种方式定制学习率，LLR促进各层之间的均衡训练，带来更快的收敛和改进的泛化。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across architectures (from LLaMa to GPT-nano), optimizers (AdamW and Muon), and parameter scales (60M–3B, up to 100B tokens) demonstrate that LLR achieves up to 1.5× training speedup and outperforms baselines, notably raising average zero-shot accuracy from 47.09% to 49.02% for 1B models and from 48.58% to 50.61% for 3B models.
sentences.zh: 跨架构（从LLaMa到GPT-nano）、优化器（AdamW和Muon）和参数规模（60M–3B，最多100B词元）的大量实验表明，LLR实现了高达1.5×的训练加速并优于基线，尤其将1B模型的平均零样本准确率从47.09\%提升到49.02\%，将3B模型从48.58\%提升到50.61\%。

sentences.en: A key advantage of LLR is its low tuning overhead: it transfers nearly optimal LR settings directly from the uniform baseline.
sentences.zh: LLR的一个关键优势是其低调优开销：它直接从统一基线迁移近乎最优的LR设置。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/hed-ucas/Layer-wise-Learning-Rate.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/hed-ucas/Layer-wise-Learning-Rate 获取。

title_en: One Model to Translate Them All: Universal Any-to-Any Translation for Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception
title_zh: 一个模型翻译全部：面向异构协作感知的通用任意到任意翻译

sentences.en: By sharing intermediate features, collaborative perception extends each agent's sensing beyond standalone limits, but real-world feature modality heterogeneity remains a key barrier to effective fusion.
sentences.zh: 通过共享中间特征，协作感知将每个智能体的感知范围扩展到单机极限之外，但真实世界特征模态的异质性仍是有效融合的关键障碍。

sentences.en: Most existing methods, including direct adaption and protocol-based transforma-tion, typically rely on training adapters for newly emerging feature modalities and often require additional retraining or fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有方法，包括直接适配和基于协议的变换，通常依赖为新兴特征模态训练适配器，并且往往需要额外的重训或微调。

sentences.en: Such repeated training is costly and is often infeasible across manufacturers due to model and data privacy con-straints, limiting real-world scalability.
sentences.zh: 这种重复训练成本高昂，且由于模型和数据隐私约束，跨制造商往往不可行，限制了现实世界的可扩展性。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose UniTrans, a universal any-to-any feature modality translation model that instantiates translators on the fly for arbitrary modalities.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出UniTrans，一个通用的任意到任意特征模态翻译模型，可为任意模态即时实例化翻译器。

sentences.en: UniTrans pretrains a bank of translator expert parameters and learns their combination coefficients as a function of source-to-target modality mapping.
sentences.zh: UniTrans预训练一个翻译器专家参数库，并学习其组合系数作为源到目标模态映射的函数。

sentences.en: The mapping is measured in a modality-intrinsic latent space, where an intrinsic encoder extracts modality-specific yet scene-invariant codes from single-frame intermediate features, enabling UniTrans to instantiate translators in a zero-shot manner.
sentences.zh: 该映射在模态内在潜在空间中度量，其中内在编码器从单帧中间特征提取模态特定但场景不变（scene-invariant）的编码，使UniTrans能够以零样本方式实例化翻译器。

sentences.en: Experiments on OPV2V-H and DAIR-V2X demonstrate that UniTrans consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both simulated and real-world set-tings, enabling efficient any-to-any translation through a universal model.
sentences.zh: 在OPV2V-H和DAIR-V2X上的实验表明，UniTrans在仿真和真实世界设定中一致地优于最先进的方法，通过通用模型实现高效的任意到任意翻译。

title_en: One Probe Won’t Catch Them All: Towards Targeted Deception Detection
title_zh: 一个探针无法全都抓住：面向目标化的欺骗检测

sentences.en: Linear probes are a promising approach for monitoring AI systems for deceptive behaviour.
sentences.zh: 线性探针是监测AI系统欺骗行为的一种有前景的方法。

sentences.en: Previous work has shown that a linear classifier trained on a contrastive instruction pair and a simple dataset can achieve good performance.
sentences.zh: 先前工作表明，在对比指令对上训练并配合简单数据集的线性分类器可以达到良好的性能。

sentences.en: However, these probes exhibit notable failures even in straightforward scenarios, including spurious correlations and false positives on non-deceptive responses.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些探针即使在直截了当的场景中也会表现出显著失败，包括虚假相关以及对非欺骗响应的误报。

sentences.en: In this paper, we demonstrate that deception detection is inherently heterogeneous: while a single universal probe achieves modest improvements (+0.032 AUC), post-hoc oracle analysis reveals substantially higher potential (+0.108 AUC) when probes are matched to specific deception types, and synthetic validation experiments suggest this ceiling is achievable a priori when the deception type is known in advance.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们证明欺骗检测本质上是异质的：虽然单个通用探针只取得适度的改进（+0.032 AUC），但事后（post-hoc）oracle分析揭示，当探针与特定欺骗类型匹配时，潜力大幅更高（+0.108 AUC），而合成验证实验表明，若事先已知欺骗类型，这一上限是先验可达到的。

sentences.en: Our findings reveal that instruction pairs capture deceptive intent rather than content-specific patterns, explaining why prompt choice dominates probe performance (70.6% of variance).
sentences.zh: 我们的发现揭示，指令对捕捉的是欺骗意图而非内容特定模式，这解释了为何提示选择主导探针性能（70.6%的方差）。

sentences.en: Given this heterogeneity, we conclude that organizations should define their specific threat models and deploy appropriately matched probes rather than seeking a universal deception detector.
sentences.zh: 鉴于这种异质性，我们得出结论：组织应定义其特定的威胁模型并部署相应匹配的探针，而非寻求一个通用欺骗检测器。

title_en: One Step Forward and K Steps Back: Better Reasoning with Denoising Recursion Models
title_zh: 向前一步再向后退K步：用去噪递归模型实现更好的推理

sentences.en: Looped transformers scale computational depth without increasing parameter count by repeatedly applying a shared transformer block and can be used for iterative refinement, where each loop rewrites a full fixed-size prediction in parallel.
sentences.zh: 循环transformer通过反复应用一个共享的transformer块，在不增加参数数量的情况下扩展计算深度，可用于迭代细化，其中每次循环并行重写一个完整固定大小的预测。

sentences.en: On difficult problems, such as those that require search-like computation, reaching a highly structured solution starting from noise can require long refinement trajectories.
sentences.zh: 在困难问题上，例如那些需要类似搜索的计算的问题，从噪声出发达到高度结构化的解可能需要很长的细化轨迹。

sentences.en: Learning such trajectories is challenging when training specifies only the target solution and provides no supervision over the intermediate refinement path.
sentences.zh: 当训练只指定目标解、而不对中间细化路径提供监督时，学习这样的轨迹就具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Diffusion models tackle this issue by corrupting data with varying magnitudes of noise and training the model to reverse it in a *single step*.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型通过用不同幅度的噪声破坏数据，并训练模型在*单步*内将其逆转来解决这一问题。

sentences.en: However, this process misaligns training and testing behaviour.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一过程会使训练与测试行为错配。

sentences.en: We introduce Denoising Recursion Models, a method that similarly corrupts data with noise but trains the model to reverse the corruption over *multiple* recursive steps.
sentences.zh: 我们引入去噪递归模型，一种类似地用噪声破坏数据、但训练模型在*多个*递归步骤中逆转这种破坏的方法。

sentences.en: This strategy provides a tractable curriculum of intermediate states, while better aligning training with testing and incentivizing non-greedy, forward-looking generation.
sentences.zh: 该策略提供了中间状态的可处理学习课程，同时使训练更好地与测试对齐，并激励非贪婪、有前瞻性的生成。

sentences.en: Through extensive experiments, we show this approach outperforms the Tiny Recursion Model (TRM) on ARC-AGI, where it recently achieved breakthrough performance.
sentences.zh: 通过大量实验，我们表明该方法在ARC-AGI上优于微递归模型（TRM），后者近期在该基准上取得了突破性性能。

title_en: One Tool Is Enough: Reinforcement Learning of LLM Agents for Repository-Level Code Navigation
title_zh: 一个工具便足够：面向仓库级代码导航的LLM智能体强化学习

sentences.en: Locating files and functions requiring modification in large software repositories is challenging due to their scale and structural complexity.
sentences.zh: 在大型软件仓库中定位需要修改的文件和函数颇具挑战性，因为其规模庞大、结构复杂。

sentences.en: Existing LLM-based methods typically treat this as a repository-level retrieval task and rely on multiple auxiliary tools, which often overlook code execution logic and complicate model control.
sentences.zh: 现有基于LLM的方法通常将其视为仓库级检索任务，并依赖多个辅助工具，这些方法往往忽视代码执行逻辑并使模型控制复杂化。

sentences.en: We propose RepoNavigator, an LLM agent equipped with a single execution-aware tool: jumping to the definition of an invoked symbol.
sentences.zh: 我们提出RepoNavigator，一个配备单一执行感知工具的LLM智能体：跳转到被调用符号的定义处。

sentences.en: This unified design reflects the actual flow of code execution while simplifying tool manipulation.
sentences.zh: 这一统一设计反映了代码执行的实际流程，同时简化了工具操作。

sentences.en: RepoNavigator is trained end-to-end via Reinforcement Learning (RL) directly from a base pretrained model, without relying on closed-source distillation.
sentences.zh: RepoNavigator通过强化学习（RL）直接从基座预训练模型端到端训练，不依赖闭源蒸馏。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that RL-trained RepoNavigator achieves state-of-the-art performance, with the 7B model outperforming 14B baselines, the 14B model surpassing 32B competitors, and the 32B model exceeding closed-source models such as GPT-5 on most metrics.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，经RL训练的RepoNavigator取得了最先进的性能：7B模型优于14B基线，14B模型超越32B竞品，32B模型在大多数指标上超过GPT-5等闭源模型。

sentences.en: These results confirm that integrating a single, structurally grounded tool with RL training provides an efficient and scalable solution for repository-level issue localization.
sentences.zh: 这些结果证实，将单一且结构上有根据的工具与RL训练相结合，为仓库级问题定位提供了一种高效且可扩展的解决方案。

title_en: One-shot Conditional Sampling: MMD meets Nearest Neighbors
title_zh: 一次性条件采样：MMD与最近邻相遇

sentences.en: How can we generate samples from a conditional distribution that we never fully observe?
sentences.zh: 我们如何从从未完整观测的条件分布中生成样本？

sentences.en: This question arises across a broad range of applications in both modern machine learning and classical statistics, including image post-processing in computer vision, approximate posterior sampling in simulation-based inference, and conditional distribution modeling in complex data settings.
sentences.zh: 这一问题出现在现代机器学习和古典统计学的广泛应用中，包括计算机视觉中的图像后处理、基于模拟推断中的近似后验采样，以及复杂数据设定中的条件分布建模。

sentences.en: In such settings, compared with unconditional sampling, additional feature information can be leveraged to enable more adaptive and efficient sampling.
sentences.zh: 在此类设定中，与无条件采样相比，可以利用额外的特征信息来实现更具适应性和更高效的采样。

sentences.en: Building on this, we introduce Conditional Generator using MMD (CGMMD), a novel framework for conditional sampling.
sentences.zh: 基于此，我们引入基于MMD的条件生成器（CGMMD），一种新颖的条件采样框架。

sentences.en: Unlike many contemporary approaches, our method frames the training objective as a simple, adversary-free direct minimization problem.
sentences.zh: 与许多当代方法不同，我们的方法将训练目标构建为一个简单、无对抗者的直接最小化问题。

sentences.en: A key feature of CGMMD is its ability to produce conditional samples in a single forward pass of the generator, enabling practical one-shot sampling with low test-time complexity.
sentences.zh: CGMMD的一个关键特性是它能通过生成器的单次前向传播产生条件样本，从而实现低测试复杂度的实用一次性采样。

sentences.en: We establish rigorous theoretical bounds on the loss incurred when sampling from the CGMMD sampler, and prove convergence of the estimated distribution to the true conditional distribution.
sentences.zh: 我们为从CGMMD采样器采样所产生的损失建立了严格的理论界，并证明估计分布收敛到真实条件分布。

sentences.en: In the process, we also develop a uniform concentration result for nearest-neighbor based functionals, which may be of independent interest.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，我们还为基于最近邻的函数泛函建立了均匀集中结果，这可能具有独立价值。

sentences.en: Finally, we show that CGMMD performs competitively on synthetic tasks involving complex conditional densities, as well as on practical applications such as image denoising and image super-resolution.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们表明CGMMD在涉及复杂条件密度的合成任务以及图像去噪和图像超分辨率等实际应用上表现有竞争力。

authors.name: Sayantan Choudhury
authors.institution: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

title_en: One-shot Entropy Minimization for Language Model Reasoning
title_zh: 面向语言模型推理的一次性熵最小化

sentences.en: In this work, we propose One-shot Entropy Minimization (EM), a simple and fully unsupervised post-training approach that significantly improves reasoning and generation performance using only a single unlabeled data and approximately ten gradient steps.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出一次性熵最小化（EM），一种简单且完全无监督的后训练方法，仅使用单个无标注数据和大约十个梯度步，就能显著提升推理与生成性能。

sentences.en: To avoid data contamination, we pretrain a 7-billion-parameter language model from scratch with strictly decontaminated data.
sentences.zh: 为避免数据污染，我们用严格去污染的数据从零预训练了一个70亿参数的语言模型。

sentences.en: Despite its extreme simplicity, one-shot EM yields substantial performance gains and improves reasoning abilities across a broad range of domains, including mathematical reasoning, logical reasoning, and coding.
sentences.zh: 尽管极其简单，一次性EM带来显著的性能增益，并在广泛领域（包括数学推理、逻辑推理和编码）提升了推理能力。

sentences.en: We further show that entropy minimization induces a characteristic right-skewed logit shift, amplifying high-probability tokens while suppressing low-probability tails, in contrast to reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步表明，与强化学习相比，熵最小化会诱发一种特征性的右偏logit偏移，放大高概率词元的同时抑制低概率尾部。

sentences.en: Our findings suggest that entropy minimization primarily acts as a distribution shaping mechanism rather than a conventional learning process, offering an efficient and practical algorithm for post-training large language models.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现表明，熵最小化主要作为一种分布塑造机制而非常规学习过程发挥作用，为后训练大语言模型提供了一种高效且实用的算法。

authors.name: Yilong Chen
authors.institution: Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences

title_en: One-Shot Weighted Ensemble Estimation for Federated Quantile Regression: Optimal Statistical Guarantees under Heterogeneous Structured Data
title_zh: 面向联邦分位数回归的一次性加权集成估计：异构结构化数据下的最优统计保证

sentences.en: Federated Quantile Regression (FQR) has emerged as a powerful modelling paradigm for estimating conditional quantiles, offering a more comprehensive understanding of response distributions than standard conditional mean regression.
sentences.zh: 联邦分位数回归（FQR）已成为估计条件分位数的强大建模范式，比标准条件均值回归能更全面地理解响应分布。

sentences.en: However, achieving communication efficiency and optimal statistical guarantees for FQR remains challenging, particularly due to the nonsmooth nature of quantile loss functions and the presence of heterogeneously structured data, where each local agent trains its conditional quantile models with distinct sets of features.
sentences.zh: 然而，为FQR实现通信效率和最优统计保证仍然具有挑战性，特别是由于分位数损失函数的非光滑性，以及存在异构结构化数据——其中每个本地智能体都使用不同的特征集训练其条件分位数模型。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a data-driven, one-shot weighted ensemble estimator for FQR that incorporates scalable weighting schemes to effectively leverage the partially observed features at each local agent, thereby enjoying both communication efficiency and estimation optimality.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们为FQR提出一种数据驱动的一次性加权集成估计器，纳入可扩展的加权方案以有效利用每个本地智能体处部分观测的特征，从而同时享有通信效率和估计最优性。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we present a unified analysis of the proposed learning procedure, establishing that the resulting estimator exhibits asymptotic normality and attains uniformly minimum variance.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们对所提出的学习过程给出统一分析，建立所得估计器具有渐近正态性并达到一致最小方差。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we investigate the estimator's sensitivity to perturbations introduced by local agents and derive conditions under which the estimator achieves stability and enjoys strong out-of-sample generalization.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们考察估计器对本地智能体所引入扰动的敏感性，并推导出估计器实现稳定性并享有强样本外泛化的条件。

sentences.en: Extensive simulations and real data analysis under various scenarios validate the asymptotic normality of our estimator and demonstrate its superior estimation accuracy and uniform convergence compared to several baseline methods across a range of quantile levels.
sentences.zh: 在多种场景下的大量模拟和真实数据分析验证了我们估计器的渐近正态性，并展示了与若干基线方法相比在多个分位水平上更优的估计精度和一致收敛性。

title_en: One-Step Gradient Delay is Not a Barrier for Large-Scale Asynchronous Pipeline Parallel LLM Pretraining
title_zh: 单步梯度延迟并非大规模异步流水线并行LLM预训练的障碍

sentences.en: Modern large-scale LLM pretraining benefits from utilizing Pipeline Parallelism; however, synchronous implementations leave GPUs idle during pipeline bubbles, wasting computational resources.
sentences.zh: 现代大规模LLM预训练受益于流水线并行；然而，同步实现在流水线气泡期间使GPU闲置，浪费计算资源。

sentences.en: Asynchronous Pipeline Parallelism eliminates these bubbles, maximizing throughput at the cost of gradient staleness.
sentences.zh: 异步流水线并行消除了这些气泡，以梯度陈旧为代价最大化吞吐量。

sentences.en: Among asynchronous schedules, PipeDream-2BW is particularly appealing: unlike the original PipeDream schedule, it ensures a constant one-step gradient delay regardless of pipeline depth.
sentences.zh: 在各种异步调度中，PipeDream-2BW尤其具有吸引力：与原始PipeDream调度不同，它无论流水线深度如何都保证恒定的单步梯度延迟。

sentences.en: However, its adoption remains limited due to the common belief that optimizing under staleness is fundamentally unstable.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于普遍认为在陈旧性下优化从根本上不稳定，其采用仍很有限。

sentences.en: In this work, we challenge this assumption, demonstrating that degradation under one-step delay depends strongly on optimizer choice rather than being an intrinsic limitation.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们挑战这一假设，证明单步延迟下的退化很大程度上取决于优化器选择，而非内在局限。

sentences.en: We provide the first comprehensive empirical analysis showing that while AdamW, the predominant optimizer at the time when PipeDream-2BW was introduced, indeed suffers from severe degradation, recent methods like Muon exhibit strong robustness under a one-step delay.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了首个全面的实证分析，表明虽然AdamW（PipeDream-2BW提出时期的主流优化器）确实遭受严重退化，但Muon等近期方法在单步延迟下表现出强鲁棒性。

sentences.en: We introduce an optimizer-agnostic Error Feedback-inspired correction to further mitigate delay effects.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一种与优化器无关的、受误差反馈启发的修正，以进一步缓解延迟效应。

sentences.en: We provide supporting theoretical analysis demonstrating convergence for Muon with and without this correction.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了支持性的理论分析，论证Muon在有无该修正下的收敛性。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluation on models up to 10B parameters confirms that our strategies bridge the performance gap with synchronous training, highlighting the practical potential of asynchronous pipeline parallelism at scale.
sentences.zh: 在多达100亿参数的模型上的大量评估证实，我们的策略弥合了与同步训练的性能差距，凸显了大规模异步流水线并行的实际潜力。

authors.name: Philip Zmushko
authors.institution: Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA)

title_en: One-Step Graph-Structured Neural Flows for  Irregular Multivariate Time Series Classification
title_zh: 面向不规则多变量时间序列分类的单步图结构化神经流

sentences.en: Neural Flows efficiently model irregular multivariate time series by directly learning ODE solution trajectories with neural networks, bypassing step-by-step numerical solvers.
sentences.zh: 神经流通过学习ODE解轨迹，其中神经网络直接学习解轨迹，绕开逐步数值求解器，从而高效地对不规则多变量时间序列建模。

sentences.en: Despite their efficiency, many existing approaches treat variables independently, leaving inter-variable interactions underexplored.
sentences.zh: 尽管效率很高，许多现有方法将变量独立处理，使得变量间相互作用未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: Moreover, their one-step mapping makes interaction modeling inherently challenging, as it removes the iterative refinement of interactions during learning.
sentences.zh: 此外，它们的单步映射使相互作用建模本质上具有挑战性，因为它在学习过程中移除了相互作用的迭代细化。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose one-step Graph-Structured Neural Flows (GSNF), which introduce two auxiliary-trajectory self-supervision strategies to strengthen interaction learning: (i) interaction-aware trajectory generation via re-initialization, which induces trajectory divergence to expose graph-induced interactions, with a theoretically derived lower bound on divergence; and (ii) reverse-time trajectory generation, which enforces forward–backward consistency to regularize graph learning, enabled by flow invertibility.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出单步图结构化神经流（GSNF），引入两种辅助轨迹自监督策略以强化相互作用学习：（i）通过重新初始化的相互作用感知轨迹生成，它诱导轨迹发散以暴露图诱导的相互作用，并具有理论上推导出的发散下界；以及（ii）逆时轨迹生成，它借助流的可逆性强制前后向一致性以正则化图学习。

sentences.en: Experiments on five real-world datasets show that GSNF achieves state-of-the-art classification performance with highly competitive training time and memory usage.
sentences.zh: 在五个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，GSNF达到了最先进的分类性能，同时训练时间和内存使用极具竞争力。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/mzgaooo/GSNF.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/mzgaooo/GSNF 获取。

title_en: One-step Latent-free Image Generation with Pixel Mean Flows
title_zh: 使用像素均值流的单步无潜在空间图像生成

sentences.en: Modern diffusion/flow-based models for image generation typically exhibit two core characteristics: (i) using multi-step sampling, and (ii) operating in a latent space.
sentences.zh: 用于图像生成的现代扩散/流模型通常表现出两个核心特征：（i）使用多步采样，以及（ii）在潜在空间中运行。

sentences.en: Recent advances have made encouraging progress on each aspect individually, paving the way toward one-step diffusion/flow without latents.
sentences.zh: 近期的进展已在每个方面分别取得了令人鼓舞的成果，为无潜在空间的一步扩散/流铺平了道路。

sentences.en: In this work, we take a further step towards this goal and propose "pixel MeanFlow" (pMF).
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们朝这一目标又迈进一步，并提出“像素MeanFlow”（pMF）。

sentences.en: Our core guideline is to formulate the network output space and the loss space separately.
sentences.zh: 我们的核心准则是将网络输出空间与损失空间分开构建。

sentences.en: The network target is designed to be on a presumed low-dimensional image manifold (i.e., x-prediction), while the loss is defined via MeanFlow in the velocity space.
sentences.zh: 网络目标被设计为位于假定的低维图像流形上（即x预测），而损失则通过速度空间中的MeanFlow定义。

sentences.en: We introduce a simple transformation between the image manifold and the average velocity field.
sentences.zh: 我们在图像流形与平均速度场之间引入一个简单的变换。

sentences.en: In experiments, pMF achieves strong results for one-step latent-free generation on ImageNet at 256$\times$256 resolution (2.22 FID) and 512$\times$512 resolution (2.48 FID), filling a key missing piece in this regime.
sentences.zh: 在实验中，pMF在256$\times$256分辨率（FID 2.22）和512$\times$512分辨率（FID 2.48）的ImageNet单步无潜在空间生成上取得了强劲结果，填补了该范式中的一个关键空白。

sentences.en: We hope that our study will further advance the boundaries of diffusion/flow-based generative models.
sentences.zh: 我们希望我们的研究能进一步推进扩散/流生成模型的边界。

title_en: One-step Optimal Transport via Regularized Distribution Matching Distillation
title_zh: 通过正则化分布匹配蒸馏实现单步最优传输

sentences.en: Unpaired domain translation remains a challenging task due to the need of finding a balance between faithfulness and realism.
sentences.zh: 无配对域翻译仍是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为它需要在忠实度与真实感之间寻找平衡。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a method called Regularized Distribution Matching Distillation (RDMD) that combines the best properties of Optimal Transport (OT) and diffusion-based domain translation methods.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出一种称为正则化分布匹配蒸馏（RDMD）的方法，它结合了最优传输（OT）和基于扩散的域翻译方法的最佳性质。

sentences.en: Instead of the conventional adversarial training, RDMD utilizes diffusion-based distribution matching, addressing the common shortcomings of OT methods and providing a strong initialization for the trained models.
sentences.zh: 与常规对抗训练不同，RDMD利用基于扩散的分布匹配，解决了OT方法的常见不足，并为训练模型提供了强初始化。

sentences.en: RDMD provides efficient one-step inference, explicitly controls the input-output alignment via regularization of the transport cost and maintains high faithfulness similar to the OT methods.
sentences.zh: RDMD提供高效的单步推理，通过正则化传输成本显式控制输入输出对齐，并保持与OT方法类似的高忠实度。

sentences.en: We prove that in theory RDMD approximates the OT map and demonstrate its empirical performance on several tasks, including unpaired image-to-image translation in pixel and latent space and unpaired text detoxification.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上证明RDMD近似OT映射，并在包括像素空间和潜在空间中的无配对图像到图像翻译以及无配对文本去毒化等多个任务上展示了其经验性能。

sentences.en: Empirical results show that RDMD achieves a comparable or better faithfulness-realism trade-off compared to the diffusion and OT baselines.
sentences.zh: 实证结果表明，与扩散和OT基线相比，RDMD实现了相当或更优的忠实度-真实感权衡。

title_en: One-Step Residual Shifting Diffusion for Image Super-Resolution via Distillation
title_zh: 通过蒸馏实现单步残差平移扩散图像超分辨率

sentences.en: Diffusion models for super-resolution (SR) produce high-quality visual results but require expensive computational costs.
sentences.zh: 用于超分辨率（SR）的扩散模型能产生高质量的视觉结果，但需要昂贵的计算成本。

sentences.en: Despite the development of several methods to accelerate diffusion-based SR models, some (e.g., SinSR) fail to produce realistic perceptual details, while others (e.g., OSEDiff) may hallucinate non-existent structures.
sentences.zh: 尽管已开发了若干方法来加速基于扩散的SR模型，但有些（如SinSR）无法产生写实的感知细节，而另一些（如OSEDiff）可能幻觉出不存在的结构。

sentences.en: To overcome these issues, we present **RSD**, a new distillation method for ResShift.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些问题，我们提出**RSD**，一种面向ResShift的新蒸馏方法。

sentences.en: Our method is based on training the student network to produce images such that a new fake ResShift model trained on them will coincide with the teacher model.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法基于训练学生网络生成图像，使得基于这些图像训练的新假ResShift模型与教师模型一致。

sentences.en: RSD achieves single-step restoration and outperforms the teacher by a noticeable margin in various perceptual metrics (LPIPS, CLIPIQA, MUSIQ).
sentences.zh: RSD实现单步恢复，并在各种感知指标（LPIPS、CLIPIQA、MUSIQ）上以明显优势超越教师模型。

sentences.en: We show that our distillation method can surpass SinSR, the other distillation-based method for ResShift, making it on par with state-of-the-art diffusion SR distillation methods with limited computational costs in terms of perceptual quality.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，我们的蒸馏方法能超越SinSR（另一种基于蒸馏的ResShift方法），使它在感知质量上以有限计算成本与最先进的扩散SR蒸馏方法并驾齐驱。

sentences.en: Compared to SR methods based on pre-trained text-to-image models, RSD produces competitive perceptual quality and requires fewer parameters, GPU memory, and training cost.
sentences.zh: 与基于预训练文生图模型的SR方法相比，RSD产生有竞争力的感知质量，且需要更少的参数、GPU内存和训练成本。

sentences.en: We provide experimental results on various real-world and synthetic datasets, including RealSR, RealSet65, DRealSR, ImageNet, and DIV2K.
sentences.zh: 我们在各种真实世界和合成数据集上提供实验结果，包括RealSR、RealSet65、DRealSR、ImageNet和DIV2K。

sentences.en: We provide the code at https://github.com/Daniil-Selikhanovych/RSD.
sentences.zh: 我们在 https://github.com/Daniil-Selikhanovych/RSD 提供代码。

authors.name: David Li
authors.institution: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI)

title_en: One-Way Policy Optimization for Self-Evolving LLMs
title_zh: 面向自进化LLM的单向策略优化

sentences.en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become a promising paradigm for scaling reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为扩展大语言模型（LLMs）推理能力的一种有前景的范式。

sentences.en: However, the sparsity of binary verifier rewards often leads to low efficiency and optimization instability.
sentences.zh: 然而，二元验证器奖励的稀疏性常常导致低效率和优化不稳定性。

sentences.en: To stabilize training, existing methods typically impose token-level constraints relative to a reference policy.
sentences.zh: 为稳定训练，现有方法通常施加相对于参考策略的词元级约束。

sentences.en: We identify that such constraints penalize deviations indiscriminately; this can flip verifier-determined direction when the policy attempts to outperform the reference, thereby suppressing gains.
sentences.zh: 我们发现这类约束不加区分地惩罚偏差；当策略试图超越参考时，这种约束会翻转验证器决定的更新方向，从而抑制收益。

sentences.en: To resolve this, we propose **One-Way Policy Optimization (OWPO)**, a method based on the principle of decoupling optimization direction from update magnitude.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出**单向策略优化（OWPO）**，一种基于将优化方向与更新幅度解耦原则的方法。

sentences.en: In OWPO, the verifier dictates the update direction, while the reference policy serves only to adjust the magnitude.
sentences.zh: 在OWPO中，验证器决定更新方向，而参考策略仅用于调整幅度。

sentences.en: Specifically, OWPO applies asymmetric reweighting: it performs **Accelerated Alignment** for Inferior deviations (where the policy lags behind the reference) and **Gain Locking** for Superior deviations (where the policy surpasses the reference).
sentences.zh: 具体而言，OWPO应用不对称重加权：对劣等偏差（策略落后于参考时）执行**加速对齐**，对优等偏差（策略超越参考时）执行**收益锁定**。

sentences.en: Furthermore, by incorporating iterative reference updates, OWPO creates a ``Ratchet Effect'' that continuously consolidates gains.
sentences.zh: 此外，通过纳入迭代参考更新，OWPO产生一种“棘轮效应”，持续巩固收益。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that OWPO outperforms strong baselines, including DAPO, OPD, and MOPD, breaking the bottleneck of fixed priors to enable continuous self-evolution without reliance on external reference models.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，OWPO优于DAPO、OPD和MOPD等强基线，突破了固定先验的瓶颈，无需依赖外部参考模型即可实现持续自进化。

authors.name: Jinda Lu
authors.institution: University of Science and Technology of China

authors.name: Kexin Huang
authors.institution: University of Science and Technology of China

title_en: OnePO: Direct One-stage Policy Optimization for SFT-free Domain Adaptation
title_zh: OnePO：面向免SFT域自适应的直接单阶段策略优化

sentences.en: Domain adaptation typically follows a two-stage pipeline: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) then Reinforcement Learning (RL).
sentences.zh: 域自适应通常遵循两阶段流程：先监督微调（SFT），再强化学习（RL）。

sentences.en: However, *does RL necessarily require a pre-SFT phase for domain adaptation?* SFT confines the model to an imitation distribution, limiting RL exploration, while the two-stage transition causes capability regression and extra engineering.
sentences.zh: 然而，*域自适应是否必然需要先进行SFT阶段？* SFT将模型限制在模仿分布内，限制了RL的探索，而两阶段过渡又造成能力退化和额外工程开销。

sentences.en: We propose **One-stage Policy Optimization (OnePO)**, an SFT-free paradigm that adapts pretrained LLMs to target domains in a single RL stage.
sentences.zh: 我们提出**单阶段策略优化（OnePO）**，一种免SFT范式，在单一的RL阶段将预训练LLM适配到目标域。

sentences.en: OnePO uses teacher outputs as transient guidance to overcome the slow convergence of pure RL, while avoiding two failures of naive teacher-output integration: gradient starvation for low-probability teacher tokens and distribution anchoring from persistent teacher signals.
sentences.zh: OnePO利用教师输出作为临时引导，以克服纯RL收敛缓慢的问题，同时避免朴素教师输出集成的两种失败：对低概率教师词元的梯度饥饿，以及来自持续教师信号的分布锚定。

sentences.en: It introduces two mechanisms: (1) *Adaptive Objective Evolution*, reshaping the RL objective for rapid absorption of teacher-provided knowledge; and (2) *Teacher Retirement*, automatically discarding teacher outputs once the model surpasses them.
sentences.zh: 它引入两种机制：（1）*自适应目标演化*，重塑RL目标以快速吸收教师提供的知识；以及（2）*教师退役*，一旦模型超越教师便自动丢弃教师输出。

sentences.en: On medical adaptation, OnePO achieves 67.2 on HealthBench with only 20K training samples, outperforming SFT+RL by +2.7 and pure RL by +7.4 points.
sentences.zh: 在医学域自适应上，OnePO仅用20K训练样本就在HealthBench上达到67.2，比SFT+RL高出+2.7分，比纯RL高出+7.4分。

sentences.en: Scaling the same recipe produces *HuatuoGPT-3*, an open-source medical LLM series whose 32B variant reaches 70.3 on HealthBench.
sentences.zh: 将该配方扩展得到*HuatuoGPT-3*，一个开源医学LLM系列，其32B变体在HealthBench上达到70.3。

sentences.en: Additional writing and legal-domain experiments show that OnePO extends beyond medicine.
sentences.zh: 额外的写作和法律域实验表明，OnePO可扩展到医学之外。

sentences.en: Models and code are available at https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/HuatuoGPT-3.
sentences.zh: 模型和代码可在 https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/HuatuoGPT-3 获取。

title_en: OneSearch: A Preliminary Exploration of the Unified End-to-End Generative Framework for E-commerce Search
title_zh: OneSearch：电商搜索统一端到端生成式框架的初步探索

sentences.en: Traditional e-commerce search systems employ multi-stage cascading architectures that suffer from fragmented computation and optimization objective collisions across stages, ultimately limiting their performance ceiling.
sentences.zh: 传统电商搜索系统采用多级级联架构，这些架构在不同阶段存在碎片化计算和优化目标冲突，最终限制了它们的性能上限。

sentences.en: We propose \textbf{OneSearch}, the first industrial-deployed end-to-end generative framework for e-commerce search, featuring three key innovations: (1) Keyword-enhanced Hierarchical Quantization Encoding to preserve hierarchical semantics and distinctive item attributes while maintaining strong query-item relevance constraints;  (2) multi-view user behavior sequence injection that constructs behavior-driven user IDs and incorporates both explicit short-term and implicit long-term sequences;  and (3) a Preference-Aware Reward System with multi-stage supervised fine-tuning and adaptive reward-weighted ranking to capture fine-grained user preferences.
sentences.zh: 我们提出\textbf{OneSearch}，首个工业部署的电商搜索端到端生成式框架，具备三项关键创新：（1）关键词增强的层级量化编码，在保持强查询-商品相关性约束的同时保留层级语义和独特商品属性；（2）多视角用户行为序列注入，构建行为驱动的用户ID并纳入显式短期和隐式长期序列；以及（3）偏好感知奖励系统，结合多阶段监督微调和自适应奖励加权排序，以捕捉细粒度用户偏好。

sentences.en: Extensive offline evaluations demonstrate its superior performance, while online A/B tests achieve statistically significant improvements: +1.67\% item CTR, +2.40\% buyer, and +3.22\% order volume.
sentences.zh: 大量离线评估展示了其优越性能，而在线A/B测试取得了统计显著的改进：商品点击率+1.67\%，买家数+2.40\%，订单量+3.22\%。

sentences.en: OneSearch reduces operational expenditure by 75.40\%, improves Model FLOPs Utilization from 3.26\% to 27.32\%, and has been successfully deployed across multiple search scenarios in Kuaishou, serving millions of users daily.
sentences.zh: OneSearch将运营支出降低75.40\%，将模型FLOPs利用率从3.26\%提升到27.32\%，并已成功部署到快手多个搜索场景，每日服务数百万用户。

sentences.en: Code is in https://github.com/benchen4395/onesearch-family.
sentences.zh: 代码见 https://github.com/benchen4395/onesearch-family。
