title_en: Optimal and Scalable MAPF via Multi-Marginal Optimal Transport and Schrödinger Bridges
title_zh: 通过多边际最优传输与Schrödinger桥实现最优且可扩展的MAPF

sentences.en: We consider anonymous multi-agent path finding (MAPF) where a set of robots is tasked to travel to a set of targets on a finite, connected graph.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑匿名多智能体路径规划（MAPF），其中一组机器人被委派在有限连通图上前往一组目标。

sentences.en: We show that MAPF can be cast as a special class of multi-marginal optimal transport (MMOT) problems with an underlying Markovian structure, under which the exponentially large MMOT collapses to a linear program (LP) polynomial in size.
sentences.zh: 我们表明MAPF可以转化为一类具有底层马尔可夫结构的特殊多边际最优传输（MMOT）问题，在这种结构下，指数规模的MMOT坍缩为大小多项式的线性规划（LP）。

sentences.en: Focusing on the anonymous setting, we establish conditions under which the corresponding LP is feasible, totally unimodular, and yields min-cost, integral~$(\{0,1\})$ transports that do not overlap in both space and time.
sentences.zh: 聚焦于匿名设定，我们建立了相应LP可行、完全幺模，并产生在空间和时间上均不重叠的最小成本整数~$(\{0,1\})$ 传输的条件。

sentences.en: To adapt the approach to large-scale problems, we cast the MAPF-MMOT in a probabilistic framework via Schrödinger bridges.
sentences.zh: 为使该方法适应大规模问题，我们通过Schrödinger桥将MAPF-MMOT置于概率框架中。

sentences.en: Under standard assumptions, we show that the Schrödinger bridge formulation reduces to an entropic regularization of the corresponding MMOT that admits an iterative Sinkhorn-type solution.
sentences.zh: 在标准假设下，我们表明Schrödinger桥公式归结为相应MMOT的熵正则化，该形式容许迭代Sinkhorn型解。

sentences.en: The Schrödinger bridge, being a probabilistic framework, provides a shadow (fractional) transport that we use as a template to solve a reduced LP and demonstrate that it results in near-optimal, integral transports at a significant reduction in complexity.
sentences.zh: Schrödinger桥作为一种概率框架，提供一种影子（分数）传输，我们将其用作求解缩减LP的模板，并证明它能以显著降低的复杂度得到近最优的整数传输。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments highlight the optimality and scalability of the proposed approaches.
sentences.zh: 大量实验突出了所提方法的最优性和可扩展性。

title_en: Optimal Anytime Algorithms for Online Convex Optimization with Adversarial Constraints
title_zh: 带对抗约束的在线凸优化的最优任意时间算法

sentences.en: We propose an anytime online algorithm for learning a sequence of convex cost functions while approximately satisfying a sequence of convex constraints, without prior knowledge of the time horizon.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种任意时间在线算法，用来学习一系列凸代价函数序列，同时近似满足一系列凸约束序列，且无需事先知道时间范围。

sentences.en: Both the cost and constraint functions may be chosen adversarially over time.
sentences.zh: 代价函数和约束函数都可能随时间被对抗性地选取。

sentences.en: While this problem has recently been resolved in the setting where the time horizon is known, extending these guarantees to the anytime setting, without resorting to inefficient doubling tricks, has remained technically challenging.
sentences.zh: 虽然该问题已在时间范围已知的设定下得到解决，但在不诉诸低效倍增技巧的情况下将这些保证扩展到任意时间设定，在技术上仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Our main contribution is the introduction of a time-varying yet horizon-oblivious Lyapunov function to track constraint violations.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要贡献是引入一个时变但对范围无知的Lyapunov函数来跟踪约束违反。

sentences.en: The use of such a time-varying Lyapunov function introduces new technical difficulties, as a key monotonicity property underlying prior analyses no longer holds.
sentences.zh: 使用这种时变Lyapunov函数引入了新的技术困难，因为先前分析所依托的一个关键单调性性质不再成立。

sentences.en: By developing a novel analytical technique, we show that our algorithm achieves $O(\sqrt{t})$ regret and $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{t})$ cumulative constraint violation (CCV) for all $t \geq 1$.
sentences.zh: 通过发展一种新颖的分析技术，我们表明对所有 $t \ge 1$，我们的算法实现 $O(\sqrt{t})$ 遗憾和 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{t})$ 累积约束违反（CCV）。

sentences.en: We further extend our framework to the dynamic regret setting, obtaining bounds that adapt to the unknown path length of the comparator sequence.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步将框架扩展到动态遗憾设定，获得适应比对序列未知路径长度的界。

sentences.en: Finally, we present an adaptive algorithm for the optimistic setting, whose performance scales gracefully with the cumulative prediction error.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们为乐观设定提出一种自适应算法，其性能随累积预测误差优雅地缩放。

sentences.en: We validate the practical effectiveness of our approach through numerical experiments on the online shortest path problem.
sentences.zh: 我们通过在在线最短路径问题上的数值实验验证了我们方法的实际有效性。

title_en: Optimal Attention Temperature Improves the Robustness of In-Context Learning under Distribution Shift in High Dimensions
title_zh: 最优注意力温度提升高维分布偏移下上下文内学习的鲁棒性

sentences.en: Pretrained Transformers can perform in-context learning (ICL) from a few demonstrations, but this ability can fail sharply when the test distribution differs from pretraining—a common deployment setting.
sentences.zh: 预训练Transformer可以从少量示例执行上下文内学习（ICL），但当测试分布与预训练分布不同时——这是一种常见的部署设定——这种能力可能急剧失效。

sentences.en: We study attention temperature as a simple inference-time control for improving ICL robustness under such shifts.
sentences.zh: 我们研究注意力温度作为改善此类偏移下ICL鲁棒性的一种简单推理时控制手段。

sentences.en: In a high-dimensional linear-regression framework, we analyze a Transformer with "approximate softmax" attention, which preserves softmax's normalization and temperature-dependent selectivity while remaining tractable.
sentences.zh: 在高维线性回归框架中，我们分析一个具有“近似softmax”注意力的Transformer，它保留softmax的归一化和温度相关的选择性，同时保持可处理性。

sentences.en: We derive a closed-form expression for the ICL generalization error under distribution shift, and show that it is minimized by an explicit optimal attention temperature.
sentences.zh: 我们推导出分布偏移下ICL泛化误差的闭式表达式，并表明它由一个显式的最优注意力温度最小化。

sentences.en: This characterization yields interpretable guidance by linking the best temperature to moments of the pre-softmax attention scores, and predicts when temperature adjustment can recover near Bayes-optimal performance.
sentences.zh: 这一刻画通过将最佳温度与pre-softmax注意力分数的矩联系起来，提供了可解释的指导，并预测了何时调整温度能恢复近Bayes最优性能。

sentences.en: We validate the theory with extensive simulations, and further demonstrate gains for pretrained LLMs on question-answering benchmarks under distribution shift induced by noisy in-context demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 我们用大量模拟验证这一理论，并进一步展示了预训练LLM在由噪声上下文内示例引起的分布偏移下，于问答基准上的收益。

sentences.en: Overall, attention temperature emerges as a principled, lightweight knob for improving the robustness of ICL in pretrained Transformers.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，注意力温度成为改善预训练Transformer中ICL鲁棒性的一种有原则的轻量级旋钮。

title_en: Optimal Bayesian Stopping for Efficient Inference of Consistent LLM Answers
title_zh: 用于高效推断一致LLM答案的最优贝叶斯停止

sentences.en: A simple strategy for improving LLM accuracy, especially in math and reasoning problems, is to sample multiple responses and submit the answer most consistently reached.
sentences.zh: 提升LLM准确率的简单策略——尤其是在数学和推理问题中——是采样多个响应，并提交最一致得出的答案。

sentences.en: In this paper we leverage Bayesian prior information to save on sampling costs, stopping once sufficient consistency is reached.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们利用贝叶斯先验信息节省采样成本，在达到充分一致性时便停止。

sentences.en: Although the exact posterior is computationally intractable, we further introduce an efficient ``$L$-aggregated'' stopping policy that tracks only the $L-1$ most frequent answer counts.
sentences.zh: 虽然精确后验在计算上不可处理，我们还引入一种高效的$L$-聚合''停止策略，只跟踪最频繁的 $L-1$ 个答案计数。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we prove that $L=3$ is all you need: this coarse approximation is sufficient to achieve asymptotic optimality, and strictly dominates prior-free baselines, while having a fast posterior computation.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们证明 $L=3$ 就足够了：这种粗略近似足以实现渐近最优性，并严格支配无先验基线，同时具有快速的后验计算。

sentences.en: Empirically, this identifies the most consistent (i.e., mode) LLM answer and achieves similar answer accuracy using fewer samples.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，这识别出最一致（即众数）的LLM答案，并用更少的样本达到相近的答案准确率。

title_en: Optimal conversion from Rényi Differential Privacy to $f$-Differential Privacy
title_zh: 从Rényi差分隐私到 $f$-差分隐私的最优转换

sentences.en: We prove the conjecture stated in Appendix F.3 of Zhu et al.: among all conversion rules that map a Rényi Differential Privacy (RDP) profile $\tau \mapsto \rho(\tau)$ to a valid hypothesis-testing trade-off $f$ (or equivalently, an $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-Differential Privacy curve), the rule based on the intersection of single-order RDP privacy regions is optimal.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了Zhu等人在附录F.3中陈述的猜想：在所有将Rényi差分隐私（RDP）谱 $τ \mapsto ρ(τ)$ 映射到有效假设检验权衡 $f$（或等价地，一条 $(ε,δ)$-差分隐私曲线）的转换规则中，基于单阶RDP隐私区域交集的规则是最优的。

sentences.en: This optimality holds simultaneously for all valid RDP profiles and for all Type I error levels $\alpha$.
sentences.zh: 该最优性对所有有效RDP谱和所有第一类误差水平 $α$ 同时成立。

sentences.en: Concretely, we show that in the space of trade-off functions, the tightest possible bound is $f_{\rho(\cdot)}(\alpha)
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们表明在权衡函数空间中，最紧的可能界是 $f_{ρ(·)}(α)$

sentences.en: = \sup_{\tau \geq 0.5} f_{\tau,\rho(\tau)}(\alpha)$: the pointwise maximum of the single-order bounds for each RDP privacy region.
sentences.zh: = $\sup_{τ \geq 0.5} f_{τ,ρ(τ)}(α)$：即每个RDP隐私区域单阶界的逐点最大。

sentences.en: Our proof unifies and sharpens the insights of Balle et al., Asoodeh et al., and Zhu et al..
sentences.zh: 我们的证明统一并强化了Balle等人、Asoodeh等人和Zhu等人的洞见。

sentences.en: Our analysis relies on a precise geometric characterization of the RDP privacy region, leveraging its convexity and the fact that its boundary is determined exclusively by Bernoulli mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析依赖于对RDP隐私区域精确的几何刻画，利用其凸性以及其边界完全由Bernoulli机制决定的这一事实。

sentences.en: Our results establish that the "intersection-of-RDP-privacy-regions" rule is not only valid, but optimal: no other black-box conversion can uniformly dominate it in the Blackwell sense, marking the fundamental limit of what can be inferred about a mechanism's privacy solely from its RDP guarantees.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果确立了“RDP隐私区域相交”规则不仅有效，而且最优：在Blackwell意义上，没有其他黑盒转换能一致地支配它，这标定了仅凭RDP保证所能推断机制隐私的根本极限。

authors.name: Julia Schnabel
authors.institution: Technical University of Munich / Helmholtz Munich, Germany and King's College London, UK

title_en: Optimal Decision-Making Based on Prediction Sets
title_zh: 基于预测集的最优决策

sentences.en: Prediction sets can wrap around any ML model to cover unknown test outcomes with a guaranteed probability.
sentences.zh: 预测集可以包裹任何ML模型，以有保证的概率覆盖未知测试结果。

sentences.en: Yet, it remains unclear how to use them optimally for downstream decision-making.
sentences.zh: 然而，尚不清楚如何在后续决策制定中最优地使用它们。

sentences.en: Here, we propose a decision-theoretic framework that seeks to minimize the expected loss (risk) against a worst-case distribution consistent with the prediction set's coverage guarantee.
sentences.zh: 在此，我们提出一个决策论框架，目标是在与预测集覆盖保证一致的最坏情况分布下最小化期望损失（风险）。

sentences.en: We first characterize the minimax optimal policy for a fixed prediction set, showing that it balances the worst-case loss inside the set with a penalty for potential losses outside the set.
sentences.zh: 我们首先刻画固定预测集的极小极大最优策略，表明它在集合内的最坏情况损失与集合外潜在损失的惩罚之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: Building on this, we derive the optimal prediction set construction that minimizes the resulting robust risk subject to a coverage constraint.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们推导出在覆盖约束下使所得鲁棒风险最小化的最优预测集构造。

sentences.en: Finally, we introduce Risk-Optimal Conformal Prediction (ROCP), a practical algorithm that targets these risk-minimizing sets while maintaining finite-sample distribution-free marginal coverage.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们引入风险最优共形预测（ROCP），一种面向这些风险最小化集合的实用算法，同时保持有限样本、无分布的边际覆盖。

sentences.en: Empirical evaluations on medical diagnosis and safety-critical decision-making tasks demonstrate that ROCP reduces critical mistakes compared to baselines, particularly when out-of-set errors are costly.
sentences.zh: 在医学诊断和安全关键决策任务上的实证评估表明，与基线相比，ROCP减少了关键错误，尤其是当集合外错误的代价高昂时。

authors.name: Tao Wang
authors.institution: The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania

title_en: Optimal Design for Multinomial Logit Model with Applications to Best Assortment Identification
title_zh: 多项Logit模型的最优设计及其在最佳分类组合识别中的应用

sentences.en: We study optimal experimental design for multinomial logit (MNL) bandits, where an agent repeatedly selects a subset of $K$ items from a ground set of size $N$ and observes single-choice feedback.
sentences.zh: 我们研究多项logit（MNL）赌博机的最优实验设计，其中智能体从规模为 $N$ 的基集中反复选择 $K$ 个物品的子集，并观察单选项反馈。

sentences.en: Unlike linear or generalized linear bandits, MNL bandits have a combinatorial action space, which makes classical optimal design approaches and naive optimization over all subsets computationally intractable.
sentences.zh: 与线性或广义线性赌博机不同，MNL赌博机具有组合动作空间，这使得经典最优设计方法和对所有子集的朴素优化在计算上不可处理。

sentences.en: We propose a computationally efficient optimal design framework for MNL models that achieves both statistical efficiency and scalability through two complementary approaches: (i) an exact or certified-approximate reformulation of the design oracle as a $0$-$1$ mixed-integer linear program (MILP) with solver-certified early stopping, and (ii) a fully polynomial-time lifted design that replaces the nonlinear objective with a tractable surrogate.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个针对MNL模型的计算高效最优设计框架，通过两种互补方法同时实现统计效率和可扩展性：（i）将设计oracle精确或经认证近似地重新表述为 $0$-$1$ 混合整数线性规划（MILP），并带求解器认证的提前停止；以及（ii）一种完全多项式时间的提升设计，用可处理的替代函数替换非线性目标。

sentences.en: Using the Kiefer-Wolfowitz equivalence theorem, we establish near G-optimality guarantees and characterize the induced statistical-computational trade-offs.
sentences.zh: 利用Kiefer-Wolfowitz等价定理，我们建立近G-最优性保证，并刻画由此产生的统计-计算权衡。

sentences.en: As an application, we develop a best assortment identification algorithm for MNL bandits with linear utilities and non-uniform revenues, and prove an instance-dependent sample complexity of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\big(\frac{d \log N}{\Delta^2}\big)$, where $d$ is the feature dimension, $N$ is the number of arms, and $\Delta$ is the minimum revenue gap.
sentences.zh: 作为应用，我们为具有线性效用和非均匀收益的MNL赌博机开发一种最佳分类组合识别算法，并证明实例相关的样本复杂度 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\big(\frac{d \log N}{\Delta^2}\big)$，其中 $d$ 是特征维度，$N$ 是臂数，$Δ$ 是最小收益间隙。

title_en: Optimal Domain-Aware Privacy Mechanisms for Synthetic Data Generation
title_zh: 面向合成数据生成的最优域感知隐私机制

sentences.en: Differential privacy (DP) imposes fundamental trade-offs between privacy and statistical fidelity in synthetic data generation.
sentences.zh: 差分隐私（DP）在合成数据生成中施加了隐私与统计保真度之间的根本性权衡。

sentences.en: While access to public data has been shown to improve these trade-offs empirically, existing approaches use public data only indirectly, through pre-processing (e.g., using pre-trained generative models) or post-processing steps (e.g., matching target statistics estimated from public datasets), while relying on domain-agnostic DP mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 虽然公共数据的访问已在经验上被证明能改善这些权衡，但现有方法只在预处理（例如使用预训练生成模型）或后处理步骤（例如匹配从公共数据集估计的目标统计量）中间接使用公共数据，同时依赖与域无关的DP机制。

sentences.en: In this work, we lay the theoretical framework to study the principled incorporation of public data into DP mechanisms themselves.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们建立理论框架，研究将公共数据原则性地纳入DP机制本身。

sentences.en: We consider normalized histograms as distribution estimators and characterize the asymptotically optimal domain-aware privacy mechanism within a specific class of DP mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 我们将归一化直方图视为分布估计器，并在特定类别的DP机制内刻画渐近最优的域感知隐私机制。

sentences.en: We introduce PubMix, a public-data-aware DP mechanism that can be used in histogram-based data synthesis pipelines.
sentences.zh: 我们引入PubMix，一种公共数据感知的DP机制，可用于基于直方图的数据合成流水线。

sentences.en: Our experiments demonstrate that PubMix significantly improves synthetic data generation quality compared to domain-agnostic privacy mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验表明，与域无关的隐私机制相比，PubMix显著提升了合成数据生成质量。

title_en: Optimal Fair Aggregation of Crowdsourced Noisy Labels using Demographic Parity Constraints
title_zh: 使用人口统计均等约束对众包噪声标签进行最优公平聚合

sentences.en: As acquiring reliable ground-truth labels is usually costly, or infeasible, crowdsourcing and aggregation of noisy human annotations is a common alternative.
sentences.zh: 由于获取可靠的真值标签通常代价高昂或不可行，众包并聚合噪声人类标注是一种常见替代方案。

sentences.en: Aggregating subjective labels, though, may amplify individual biases, particularly regarding sensitive features, raising fairness concerns.
sentences.zh: 然而，聚合主观标签可能放大个体偏见，尤其是涉及敏感特征时，从而引发公平性担忧。

sentences.en: Nonetheless, fairness in crowdsourced aggregation remains largely unexplored, with no existing convergence guarantees and only limited post-processing approaches for enforcing $\varepsilon$-fairness under demographic parity.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，众包聚合中的公平性仍基本未被探索，既没有现有的收敛保证，也只有有限的后处理方法能在人口统计均等下强制执行 $ε$-公平性。

sentences.en: We address this gap by analyzing the fairness of  crowdsourced aggregation methods within the $\varepsilon$-fairness framework, for Majority Vote and Optimal Bayesian aggregation.
sentences.zh: 我们通过研究 $ε$-公平性框架下多数投票和最优贝叶斯聚合等众包聚合方法的公平性来弥补这一空白。

sentences.en: In the small-crowd regime, we derive an upper bound on the fairness gap of Majority Vote in terms of the fairness gaps of the individual annotators.
sentences.zh: 在小群体情形下，我们以个体标注者的公平性缺口推导出多数投票公平性缺口的上界。

sentences.en: We further show that the fairness gap of the aggregated consensus converges exponentially fast to that of the ground-truth under interpretable conditions.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步表明，在可解释条件下，聚合共识的公平性缺口以指数速度收敛到真值的公平性缺口。

sentences.en: Since ground-truth itself may still be unfair, we generalize a state-of-the-art multiclass fairness post-processing algorithm from the continuous to the discrete setting, which enforces  strict demographic parity constraints on any aggregation rule.
sentences.zh: 由于真值本身可能仍不公平，我们将一种最先进的多类公平性后处理算法从连续设定推广到离散设定，该算法对任何聚合规则强制执行严格的人口统计均等约束。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach and corroborate the theoretical insights.
sentences.zh: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验展示了我们方法的有效性，并证实了理论洞见。

title_en: Optimal Learning from Label Proportions with General Loss Functions
title_zh: 带通用损失函数的最优标签比例学习

sentences.en: Motivated by problems in online advertising, we address the task of Learning from Label Proportions (LLP).
sentences.zh: 受在线广告问题的启发，我们解决标签比例学习（LLP）任务。

sentences.en: We introduce a novel and versatile low-variance debiasing methodology to learn from aggregate label information, significantly advancing the state of the art in LLP.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一种新颖且通用的低方差去偏方法，用于从聚合标签信息中学习，显著推进了LLP的最先进水平。

sentences.en: Our debiasing approach exhibits remarkable flexibility, seamlessly accommodating a broad spectrum of practically relevant loss functions across both binary and multi-class classification settings.
sentences.zh: 我们的去偏方法表现出显著的灵活性，在二分类和多分类设定中都能无缝容纳广泛的实用损失函数。

sentences.en: By carefully combining our estimators with standard techniques, we improve sample complexity guarantees for a large class of losses of practical relevance.
sentences.zh: 通过将我们的估计器与标准技术仔细结合，我们改善了一大类具有实际意义的损失的样本复杂度保证。

sentences.en: We also empirically validate the efficacy of our proposed approach across a diverse array of benchmark datasets, demonstrating compelling empirical advantages over standard baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们还跨多样的基准数据集实证验证了我们所提方法的有效性，展示了相对标准基线的令人信服的实证优势。

title_en: Optimal Pricing for Data-Augmented AutoML Marketplaces
title_zh: 面向数据增强AutoML市场的最优定价

sentences.en: Data markets promise to unlock data value by matching data suppliers with ML consumers.
sentences.zh: 数据市场承诺通过将数据供应商与ML消费者匹配，释放数据价值。

sentences.en: However, market design involves addressing intricate challenges, including data pricing, fairness, and robustness.
sentences.zh: 然而，市场设计涉及应对数据定价、公平性和鲁棒性等复杂挑战。

sentences.en: We propose a pragmatic data-augmented AutoML market that seamlessly integrates with existing cloud-based AutoML platforms, such as Google’s Vertex AI.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个务实的数据增强AutoML市场，与Google’s Vertex AI等现有基于云的AutoML平台无缝集成。

sentences.en: Unlike standard AutoML solutions, our design automatically augments buyer-submitted training data with valuable external datasets, pricing the resulting models based on their measurable performance improvements rather than computational costs as the status quo.
sentences.zh: 与标准AutoML解决方案不同，我们的设计自动用有价值的外部数据集增强买方提交的训练数据，并根据模型可测的性能提升而非现状的计算成本为所得模型定价。

sentences.en: Our key innovation is a pricing mechanism grounded in the instrumental value—the marginal model quality improvement—of externally sourced data.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键创新是一种基于外部数据工具价值（边际模型质量改进）的定价机制。

sentences.en: This approach bypasses direct dataset pricing complexities and accommodates diverse buyer valuations through menu-based options, thus providing an economically sustainable framework for monetizing external data.
sentences.zh: 这种方法绕过了直接数据集定价的复杂性，并通过基于菜单的选项容纳多样的买方估值，从而为外部数据变现提供了一个经济上可持续的框架。

topic: Probabilistic Methods->Monte Carlo and Sampling Methods
title_en: Optimal Quantum Speedups for Repeatedly Nested Expectation Estimation
title_zh: 反复嵌套期望估计的最优量子加速

sentences.en: We study the estimation of repeatedly nested expectations (RNEs) with a constant horizon (number of nestings) using quantum computing.
sentences.zh: 我们研究使用量子计算估计具有恒定视界（嵌套层数）的反复嵌套期望（RNEs）。

sentences.en: We propose a quantum algorithm that achieves $\varepsilon$-error with cost $\tilde O(\varepsilon^{-1})$, up to logarithmic factors.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种量子算法，以 $\tilde O(ε^{-1})$ 成本实现 $ε$-误差，达到对数因子。

sentences.en: Standard lower bounds show this scaling is essentially optimal, yielding an almost quadratic speedup over the best classical algorithm.
sentences.zh: 标准下界表明这一缩放本质上是最优的，相比最佳经典算法实现近二次加速。

sentences.en: Our results extend prior quantum speedups for single nested expectations to repeated nesting, and therefore cover a broader range of applications, including optimal stopping.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果将先前对单层嵌套期望的量子加速扩展到反复嵌套，从而覆盖更广泛的应用，包括最优停止。

sentences.en: This extension requires a new derandomized variant of the classical randomized Multilevel Monte Carlo (rMLMC) algorithm.
sentences.zh: 这一扩展需要经典随机化多层蒙特卡洛（rMLMC）算法的一个新的去随机化变体。

sentences.en: Careful de-randomization is key to overcoming a variable-time issue that typically increases quantized versions of classical randomized algorithms.
sentences.zh: 细致的去随机化是克服变长时间问题的关键，该问题通常会增大经典随机化算法的量子化版本。

title_en: Optimal Rates for Feasible Payoff Set Estimation in Games
title_zh: 博弈中可行收益集合估计的最优速率

sentences.en: We study a setting in which two players play a (possibly approximate) Nash equilibrium of a bimatrix game, while a learner observes only their actions and has no knowledge of the equilibrium or the underlying game.
sentences.zh: 我们研究这样一种设定：两个玩家进行一个双矩阵游戏的（可能是近似的）Nash均衡，而学习器只观察他们的行动，对其中的均衡或底层博弈一无所知。

sentences.en: A natural question is whether the learner can rationalize the observed behavior by inferring the players' payoff functions.
sentences.zh: 一个自然的问题是，学习器能否通过推断玩家的收益函数来使观察到的行为合理化。

sentences.en: Rather than producing a single payoff estimate, inverse game theory aims to identify the entire set of payoffs consistent with observed behavior, enabling downstream use in, e.g., counterfactual analysis and mechanism design across applications like auctions, pricing, and security games.
sentences.zh: 逆向博弈论不是产生单一的收益估计，而是旨在识别与观察行为一致的整个收益集合，从而支持在拍卖、定价和安全博弈等应用中用于反事实分析和机制设计。

sentences.en: We focus on the problem of estimating the set of feasible payoffs with high probability and up to precision $\epsilon$ on the Hausdorff metric.
sentences.zh: 我们聚焦于以高概率估计可行收益集合、并在Hausdorff度量下达到 $ε$ 精度的问题。

sentences.en: We provide the first minimax-optimal rates for both exact and approximate equilibrium play, in zero-sum as well as general-sum games.
sentences.zh: 我们为精确和近似均衡玩法提供了首个极小极大最优速率，涵盖零和博弈以及一般和博弈。

sentences.en: Our results provide learning-theoretic foundations for set-valued payoff inference in multi-agent environments.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果为多智能体环境中的集值收益推断提供了学习理论基础。

title_en: Optimal Regret for Policy Optimization in Contextual Bandits
title_zh: 上下文赌博机中策略优化的最优遗憾

sentences.en: We present the first high-probability optimal regret bound for a policy optimization technique applied to the problem of stochastic contextual multi-armed bandit (CMAB) with general offline function approximation.
sentences.zh: 我们给出首个高概率最优遗憾界，适用于带通用离线函数逼近的随机上下文多臂赌博机（CMAB）问题所采用的策略优化技术。

sentences.en: Our algorithm is both efficient and achieves an optimal regret bound of $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{ K|\mathcal{A}|\log|\mathcal{F}|})$, where $K$ is the number of rounds, $\mathcal{A}$ is the set of arms, and $\mathcal{F}$ is the function class used to approximate the losses.
sentences.zh: 我们的算法既高效，又实现了 $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{ K|\mathcal{A}|\log|\mathcal{F}|})$ 的最优遗憾界，其中 $K$ 是轮数，$\mathcal{A}$ 是臂集合，$\mathcal{F}$ 是用于逼近损失的函数类。

sentences.en: Our results bridge the gap between theory and practice, demonstrating that the widely used policy optimization methods for the contextual bandit problem can achieve a rigorously-proved optimal regret bound.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果弥合了理论与实践之间的差距，证明广泛使用的用于上下文赌博机问题的策略优化方法能实现严格证明的最优遗憾界。

sentences.en: We support our theoretical results with an empirical evaluation of our algorithm.
sentences.zh: 我们通过算法的实证评估来支持我们的理论结果。

title_en: Optimal Regularization for Performative Learning
title_zh: 表现性学习的最优正则化

sentences.en: In performative learning, the data distribution reacts to the deployed model—for example, because strategic users adapt their features to game it—which creates a more complex dynamic than in classical supervised learning.
sentences.zh: 在表现性学习中，数据分布会对已部署模型作出反应——例如，因为策略性用户会调整其特征来应对它——这比经典监督学习产生了更复杂的动态。

sentences.en: One should thus not only optimize the model for the current data but also take into account that the model might steer the distribution in a new direction, without knowing the exact nature of the potential shift.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们不仅应当为当前数据优化模型，还应考虑到模型可能将分布引向新的方向，而无需知道潜在偏移的确切性质。

sentences.en: We explore how regularization can help cope with performative effects by studying its impact in high-dimensional ridge regression.
sentences.zh: 我们通过研究正则化在高维岭回归中的影响，探索它如何帮助应对表现效应。

sentences.en: We show that, while performative effects worsen the test risk in the population setting, when moving to the over-parameterized regime where the number of features exceeds the number of samples, the optimal regularization in the presence of performativity helps reduce the variance in the estimated parameters, thereby improving performance.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，虽然表现效应在总体设定中恶化了测试风险，但当进入特征数超过样本数的过参数化区间时，存在表现性时的最优正则化有助于降低估计参数的方差，从而提升性能。

sentences.en: We show that the optimal regularization scales with the overall strength of the performative effect, making it possible to set the regularization in anticipation of this effect.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，最优正则化随表现效应的总强度缩放，从而可以在预期该效应的前提下设置正则化。

sentences.en: We illustrate this finding through empirical evaluations of the optimal regularization parameter on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
sentences.zh: 我们通过对合成和真实数据集上最优正则化参数的实证评估来阐释这一发现。

title_en: Optimal Self-Consistency for Efficient Reasoning with Large Language Models
title_zh: 面向大语言模型高效推理的最优自一致性

sentences.en: Self-consistency (SC) is a widely-used test-time inference technique for improving performance in chain-of-thought reasoning.
sentences.zh: 自一致性（SC）是一种广泛使用的测试时推理技术，用于提升思维链推理的性能。

sentences.en: It consists of generating multiple responses, or "samples," from a large language model (LLM) and selecting the most frequent answer.
sentences.zh: 它包括从大语言模型（LLM）生成多个响应或“样本”，并选择出现最频繁的答案。

sentences.en: This procedure can naturally be viewed as a majority vote or empirical mode estimation.
sentences.zh: 这一过程自然可以被视为多数投票或经验众数估计。

sentences.en: Despite its effectiveness, self-consistency is prohibitively expensive at scale when naively applied to datasets, and it lacks a unified theoretical treatment of sample efficiency and scaling behavior.
sentences.zh: 尽管有效，但当朴素地应用于数据集时，自一致性在规模上代价极其高昂，并且缺乏对样本效率和缩放行为的统一理论处理。

sentences.en: In this paper, we provide the first comprehensive analysis of SC's scaling behavior and its variants, drawing on mode estimation and voting theory.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们借鉴众数估计和投票理论，提供关于SC缩放行为及其变体的首次综合分析。

sentences.en: We derive and empirically validate power law scaling for self-consistency across datasets, and analyze the sample efficiency for fixed-allocation and dynamic-allocation sampling schemes.
sentences.zh: 我们推导并实证验证了自一致性跨数据集的幂律缩放，并分析了固定分配和动态分配采样方案的样本效率。

sentences.en: From these insights, we introduce Blend-ASC, a novel variant of self-consistency that dynamically allocates samples to questions during inference, achieving state-of-the-art sample efficiency.
sentences.zh: 基于这些洞见，我们引入Blend-ASC，一种自一致性的新颖变体，在推理期间动态分配样本给问题，实现最先进的样本效率。

sentences.en: Our approach uses $4.8\times$ fewer samples than vanilla SC on average, outperforming both fixed- and dynamic-allocation SC baselines, thereby demonstrating the superiority of our approach in terms of efficiency.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法平均比朴素SC少用 $4.8\times$ 样本，优于固定分配和动态分配的SC基线，从而展示了我们方法在效率方面的优越性。

sentences.en: In contrast to existing variants, we note that Blend-ASC is hyperparameter-free and can fit any budget of samples, ensuring it can be easily applied to any self-consistency application.
sentences.zh: 与现有变体相比，我们指出Blend-ASC免超参数，且能适配任意样本预算，确保它能轻松应用于任何自一致性应用。

authors.name: Ambroise Odonnat
authors.institution: Noah's Ark Lab, Inria, Univ. Rennes 2

title_en: Optimal Splitting of Language Models from Mixtures to Specialized Domains
title_zh: 语言模型从混合到专业领域的最优拆分

sentences.en: Language models achieve impressive performance on a variety of knowledge, language, and reasoning tasks due to the scale and diversity of pretraining data available.
sentences.zh: 语言模型凭借可用预训练数据的规模和多样性，在各类知识、语言和推理任务上取得了令人瞩目的性能。

sentences.en: The standard training recipe is a two-stage paradigm: pretraining first on the full corpus of data followed by specialization on a  subset of high quality, specialized data from the full corpus.
sentences.zh: 标准训练流程是两阶段范式：先在完整语料上进行预训练，然后在全语料中高质量、专业化的子集上进行专化。

sentences.en: In the multi-domain setting, this involves continued pretraining of multiple models on each specialized domain, referred to as split model training.
sentences.zh: 在多领域设定中，这涉及在每个专业领域上对多个模型进行继续预训练，称为拆分模型训练。

sentences.en: We propose a method for pretraining multiple models independently over a general pretraining corpus, and determining the optimal compute allocation between pretraining and continued pretraining using scaling laws.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种方法，在通用预训练语料上独立预训练多个模型，并使用缩放律确定预训练与继续预训练之间的最优计算分配。

sentences.en: Our approach accurately predicts the loss of a model of size $N$ with $D$ pretraining and $D'$ specialization tokens, and extrapolates to larger model sizes and number of tokens.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法准确预测了规模为 $N$ 且具有 $D$ 个预训练词元和 $D'$ 个专化词元的模型的损失，并可外推到更大模型规模和更多词元。

sentences.en: Applied to language model training, our approach improves performance consistently across common sense knowledge and reasoning benchmarks across different model sizes and compute budgets.
sentences.zh: 应用于语言模型训练时，我们的方法在不同模型规模和计算预算下，于常识知识和推理基准上一致地提升了性能。

title_en: Optimal Stopping in Latent Diffusion Models
title_zh: 潜在扩散模型中的最优停止

sentences.en: We identify and analyze a surprising phenomenon of $\textit{Latent}$ Diffusion Models (LDMs) where the final steps of the diffusion can $\textit{degrade}$ sample quality.
sentences.zh: 我们识别并分析\textit{潜在}扩散模型（LDMs）中一个令人惊讶的现象：扩散的最后步骤可能\textit{降低}样本质量。

sentences.en: In contrast to conventional arguments that justify early stopping for numerical stability, this phenomenon is intrinsic to the dimensionality reduction in LDMs.
sentences.zh: 与为数值稳定性而证明提前停止合理的常规论证相反，这一现象是LDM中维度缩减的内在属性。

sentences.en: We provide a principled explanation by analyzing the interaction between latent dimension and stopping time.
sentences.zh: 我们通过分析潜在维度与停止时间之间的相互作用，提供了有原则的解释。

sentences.en: Under a Gaussian framework with linear autoencoders, we characterize the conditions under which early stopping is needed to minimize the distance between generated and target distributions.
sentences.zh: 在线性自编码器的高斯框架下，我们刻画了为最小化生成分布与目标分布之间距离而需要提前停止的条件。

sentences.en: More precisely, we show that lower-dimensional representations benefit from earlier termination, whereas higher-dimensional latent spaces require later stopping time.
sentences.zh: 更精确地说，我们表明较低维表示受益于更早的终止，而较高维潜在空间需要更晚的停止时间。

sentences.en: We further establish that the latent dimension interplays with other hyperparameters of the problem such as constraints in the parameters of score matching.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步确立，潜在维度与问题其他超参数（如分数匹配参数中的约束）相互作用。

sentences.en: Crucially, this framework suggests that the reconstruction quality of the autoencoder alone can serve as a proxy to estimate the potential performance of the full LDM.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，这一框架表明，仅凭自编码器的重建质量就可以作为估计完整LDM潜在性能的代理。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic and real datasets illustrate these properties, underlining that early stopping can improve generative quality.
sentences.zh: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验阐释了这些性质，强调提前停止能提升生成质量。

sentences.en: Together, our results offer a theoretical foundation for understanding how the latent dimension influences the sample quality, and highlight stopping time as a key hyperparameter in LDMs.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果共同为理解潜在维度如何影响样本质量提供了理论基础，并强调停止时间是LDM中的一个关键超参数。

authors.name: Yu-Han Wu
authors.institution: Sorbonne Université - Faculté des Sciences (Paris VI)

title_en: Optimal structure learning and conditional independence testing
title_zh: 最优结构学习与条件独立性检验

sentences.en: We establish a fundamental connection between optimal structure learning and optimal conditional independence testing by showing that the minimax optimal rate for structure learning problems is determined by the minimax rate for conditional independence testing in these problems.
sentences.zh: 我们确立了最优结构学习与最优条件独立性检验之间的根本联系，表明结构学习问题的极小极大最优速率由这些问题中条件独立性检验的极小极大速率决定。

sentences.en: This is accomplished by establishing a general reduction between these two problems in the case of poly-forests, and demonstrated by deriving optimal rates for several examples, including Bernoulli, Gaussian and nonparametric models.
sentences.zh: 这是通过在多项式树情形下建立这两个问题的通用归约实现的，并通过推导若干示例（包括Bernoulli、高斯和非参数模型）的最优速率加以展示。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we show that the optimal algorithm in these settings is a suitable modification of the PC algorithm.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们表明在这些设定中的最优算法是PC算法的一个适当修改。

sentences.en: This theoretical finding provides a unified framework for analyzing the statistical complexity of structure learning through the lens of minimax testing.
sentences.zh: 这一理论发现为通过极小极大检验的视角分析结构学习的统计复杂度提供了统一框架。

topic: General Machine Learning->Online Learning, Active Learning and Bandits
title_en: Optimal Top-$k$ Identification from Pairwise Comparisons
title_zh: 从成对比较中进行最优Top-$k$识别

sentences.en: We study the active learning problem of fixed-confidence top-$k$ identification from noisy pairwise comparisons.
sentences.zh: 我们研究从噪声成对比较中进行固定置信度Top-$k$识别这一主动学习问题。

sentences.en: In this problem, an algorithm sequentially chooses pairs of items to compare, observes the outcomes, and stops when it can return the set of top-$k$ items with error probability at most $\delta$.
sentences.zh: 在该问题中，算法顺序选择要比较的物品对，观察结果，当能以至多 $δ$ 的错误概率返回Top-$k$物品集时停止。

sentences.en: The objective is to design such a *$\delta$-correct* procedure that minimizes the expected number of comparisons (the sample complexity).
sentences.zh: 目标是设计这样一个*$δ$-正确*的过程，使期望比较次数（样本复杂度）最小化。

sentences.en: This problem falls within the broader literature on fixed-confidence pure exploration in bandit models, where a common target is asymptotic optimality: the algorithm's expected sample complexity matches the information theoretic lower bound as $\delta \to 0$.
sentences.zh: 该问题属于赌博机模型中固定置信度纯探索的更广泛文献，其中常见目标是渐近最优性：算法的期望样本复杂度在 $δ \to 0$ 时匹配信息论下界。

sentences.en: Asymptotically optimal procedures have been developed for a range of fixed-confidence pure-exploration problems, however to the best of our knowledge, for top-$1$, or more generally top-$k$ identification from pairwise comparisons under latent utility models an asymptotically optimal algorithm has not been established.
sentences.zh: 虽然针对一系列固定置信度纯探索问题已开发出渐近最优过程，但据我们所知，对于潜在效用模型下从成对比较进行Top-$1$、或更一般地Top-$k$识别，尚未建立渐近最优算法。

sentences.en: In this setting, we develop such an algorithm.
sentences.zh: 在此设定中，我们开发了这样一个算法。

sentences.en: We characterize the structure of the lower bound and formulate it as a saddle-point problem.
sentences.zh: 我们刻画了下界的结构，并将其构建为鞍点问题。

sentences.en: This structure enables a computationally efficient primal--dual procedure that learns the asymptotically optimal comparison allocation online.
sentences.zh: 这种结构使一种计算高效的原始-对偶过程能够在线学习渐近最优的比较分配。

sentences.en: We then construct an adaptive comparison-allocation algorithm that tracks the allocation learned by the primal--dual procedure and prove it is asymptotically optimal.
sentences.zh: 然后我们构造一种自适应的比较分配算法，跟踪原始-对偶过程学到的分配，并证明它是渐近最优的。

title_en: Optimal Transport for LLM Reward Modeling from Noisy Feedback
title_zh: 从噪声反馈进行LLM奖励建模的最优传输

sentences.en: Reward models are fundamental to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), yet real-world datasets are inevitably corrupted by noisy preference.
sentences.zh: 奖励模型是从人类反馈中进行强化学习（RLHF）的基础，然而现实世界的数据集不可避免地受噪声偏好污染。

sentences.en: Conventional training objectives tend to overfit these errors, while existing denoising approaches often rely on homogeneous noise assumptions that fail to capture the complexity of linguistic preferences.
sentences.zh: 常规训练目标往往过拟合这些误差，而现有去噪方法通常依赖无法捕捉语言偏好复杂性的同质噪声假设。

sentences.en: To handle these challenges, we propose SelectiveRM, a framework grounded in optimal transport.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出SelectiveRM，一个基于最优传输的框架。

sentences.en: We first devise a Joint Consistency Discrepancy to align the distribution of model predictions with preference data.
sentences.zh: 我们首先设计一种联合一致性差异，以使模型预测的分布与偏好数据对齐。

sentences.en: Furthermore, to address the limitation of strict mass conservation which compels the model to fit outliers, we incorporate a Mass Relaxation mechanism via partial transport.
sentences.zh: 此外，为解决迫使模型拟合异常值的严格质量守恒的局限性，我们通过部分传输纳入一种质量松弛机制。

sentences.en: This enables the autonomous exclusion of samples with noisy preference that contradict semantic consistency.
sentences.zh: 这使得能够自主排除具有与语义一致性相矛盾的噪声偏好的样本。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we demonstrate that SelectiveRM optimizes a tighter upper bound on the unobserved clean risk.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们证明SelectiveRM优化了未观测干净风险上的一个更紧上界。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments validate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across diverse benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 大量实验验证我们的方法在多个基准上显著优于最先进的基线。

authors.name: Lei Shen
authors.institution: Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

title_en: Optimal Transport Group Counterfactual Explanations
title_zh: 最优传输组反事实解释

sentences.en: Group counterfactual explanations find a set of counterfactual instances to explain a group of input instances contrastively.
sentences.zh: 组反事实解释寻找一组反事实实例，以对照方式解释一组输入实例。

sentences.en: However, existing methods either (i) optimize counterfactuals only for a fixed group and do not generalize to new group members, (ii) strictly rely on strong model assumptions (e.g., linearity) for tractability and/or (iii) poorly control the counterfactual group geometry distortion.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法要么（i）仅为固定组优化反事实且不推广到新组成员，要么（ii）严格依赖强模型假设（如线性）以实现可处理性，和/或（iii）对反事实组的几何失真控制不佳。

sentences.en: We instead learn an explicit optimal transport map that sends any group instance to its counterfactual without re-optimization, minimizing the group's total transport cost.
sentences.zh: 我们转而学习一个显式的最优传输映射，在不重新优化的情况下将任何组实例送到其反事实，同时最小化组的总传输成本。

sentences.en: This enables generalization with fewer parameters, making it easier to interpret the common actionable recourse.
sentences.zh: 这使得以更少参数实现泛化，更容易解释通用的可行动补救。

sentences.en: For linear classifiers, we prove that functions representing group counterfactuals are derived via mathematical optimization, identifying the underlying convex optimization type
sentences.zh: 对于线性分类器，我们证明表示组反事实的函数可通过数学优化推导得出，识别出底层的凸优化类型

sentences.en: (QP, QCQP, ...). Experiments show that they accurately generalize,  preserve group geometry and incur only negligible additional transport cost compared to baseline methods.
sentences.zh: （QP，QCQP，...）。实验表明，它们能准确泛化、保持组几何，并且与基线方法相比仅产生可忽略的额外传输成本。

sentences.en: If model linearity cannot be exploited, our approach also significantly outperforms the baselines.
sentences.zh: 如果模型线性无法被利用，我们的方法也显著优于基线。

authors.name: Pedro Larrañaga
authors.institution: Universidad Politécnica de Madrid, Universidad Politécnica de Madrid

title_en: Optimal Transport under Group Fairness Constraints
title_zh: 群公平约束下的最优传输

sentences.en: Ensuring fairness in matching algorithms is a key challenge in allocating scarce resources and positions.
sentences.zh: 在分配稀缺资源和职位时，确保匹配算法的公平性是一个关键挑战。

sentences.en: Focusing on Optimal Transport (OT), we introduce a novel notion of group fairness requiring that the probability of matching two individuals from any two given groups in the OT plan satisfies a predefined target.
sentences.zh: 聚焦于最优传输（OT），我们引入一种新颖的群公平概念，要求OT方案中匹配任意两个给定群组的两个个体的概率满足一个预定义目标。

sentences.en: We first propose a modified Sinkhorn algorithm to compute perfectly fair transport plans efficiently.
sentences.zh: 我们首先提出一种改进的Sinkhorn算法，以高效计算完全公平的传输方案。

sentences.en: Since exact fairness can significantly degrade matching quality in practice, we then develop two relaxation strategies.
sentences.zh: 由于在实践中完全公平可能显著降低匹配质量，接着我们开发两种松弛策略。

sentences.en: The first one involves solving a penalized OT problem, for which we derive novel finite-sample complexity guarantees.
sentences.zh: 第一种涉及求解一个惩罚OT问题，我们为其推导新颖的有限样本复杂度保证。

sentences.en: Our second strategy leverages bilevel optimization to learn a ground cost that induces a fair OT solution, and we establish a bound on the deviation of fairness when matching unseen data.
sentences.zh: 我们的第二种策略利用双层优化学习一个诱导公平OT解的基础成本，并建立匹配未见数据时公平性偏差的界。

sentences.en: Finally, we present empirical results illustrating the performance of our approaches and the trade-off between fairness and transport cost.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们给出实证结果，展示我们方法的性能以及公平性与传输成本之间的权衡。

title_en: Optimal Transport with Symmetry Groups
title_zh: 带对称群的最优传输

sentences.en: We propose a novel algorithm that accelerates optimal transport by exploiting intrinsic symmetries induced by finite group actions.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种新算法，通过利用有限群作用诱导的内在对称性来加速最优传输。

sentences.en: The core of our approach is to recover the orbit decomposition and the associated algebraic structure directly from the cost matrix—without requiring prior knowledge of the group—and to reduce the original transport problem to a substantially smaller problem on the orbit space.
sentences.zh: 我们方法的核心是直接从成本矩阵恢复轨道分解及相应代数结构，而无需事先知道群，并将原始传输问题归约为轨道空间上一个小得多的问题。

sentences.en: This reduction preserves optimality while achieving a significant drop in computational complexity.
sentences.zh: 这一归约在保持最优性的同时实现了计算复杂度的显著下降。

sentences.en: We develop efficient solvers for two central classes of optimal transport: linear OT and entropy-regularized OT.
sentences.zh: 我们为最优传输的两类核心情形开发高效求解器：线性OT和熵正则化OT。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic data, real-world image datasets, and molecular graph data confirm the efficiency and robustness of the method.
sentences.zh: 在合成数据、真实世界图像数据集和分子图数据上的实验证实了该方法的效率和鲁棒性。

sentences.en: To our knowledge, this work is the first to systematically incorporate symmetry groups into optimal transport, providing both a theoretical framework and a practical pathway to computational acceleration.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，本工作首次系统性地将对称群纳入最优传输，既提供了理论框架，也提供了通往计算加速的实用途径。

title_en: Optimal Transport–Guided Stochastic Control for Graph Combinatorial Optimization
title_zh: 最优传输引导的图组合优化随机控制

sentences.en: We propose an OT-guided sampling framework for solving graph combinatorial optimization through exact multilinear relaxation.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个OT引导的采样框架，通过精确多线性松弛求解图组合优化。

sentences.en: Graph combinatorial optimization problems can be written as quadratic unconstrained binary optimization(QUBO).
sentences.zh: 图组合优化问题可以写成二次无约束二值优化（QUBO）。

sentences.en: Leveraging a classical result in combinatorial optimization, we obtain a continuous multi-linear relaxation of QUBO that is exact, in the sense that it preserves the optimal binary solutions.
sentences.zh: 利用组合优化中的一个经典结果，我们获得QUBO的一个连续多线性松弛，它在该松弛保持最优二值解的意义上是精确的。

sentences.en: The challenge is that the resulting energy landscape is highly nonconvex.
sentences.zh: 挑战在于由此产生的能量景观是高度非凸的。

sentences.en: We address this by treating the objective as an energy function and optimizing via sampling from the induced Boltzmann distribution to escape poor local optima.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将目标视为能量函数，并借助从由此诱导的Boltzmann分布采样来逃逸差的局部最优，从而解决这一问题。

sentences.en: Viewing sampling as transporting a simple reference distribution to the target distribution, we use optimal transport to characterize more efficient probability flow and derive a stochastic optimal control problem whose solution yields an optimal sampling dynamics.
sentences.zh: 将采样视为将简单参考分布传输到目标分布，我们使用最优传输刻画更高效的概率流，并推导出一个随机最优控制问题，其解产生最优采样动力学。

sentences.en: We parameterize the control policy with graph neural networks to approximate the optimal control.
sentences.zh: 我们用图神经网络参数化控制策略以逼近最优控制。

sentences.en: Experiments show improved solution quality and efficiency over strong combinatorial and learning-based baselines.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，在强组合基线和基于学习的基线上，解的质量和效率都有所提升。

authors.name: Yifan Zhang
authors.institution: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

title_en: Optimal Unconstrained Self-Distillation in Ridge Regression: Strict Improvements, Precise Asymptotics, and One-Shot Tuning
title_zh: 岭回归中最优无约束自蒸馏：严格改进、精确渐近与单次调参

sentences.en: Self-distillation (SD) is the process of retraining a student on a mixture of ground-truth labels and the teacher’s own predictions using the same architecture and training data.
sentences.zh: 自蒸馏（SD）是使用相同架构和训练数据，在真值标签与教师自身预测的混合上重训学生的过程。

sentences.en: Although SD has been empirically shown to often improve generalization, its formal guarantees remain limited.
sentences.zh: 虽然SD在经验上已被证明常常能改进泛化，但其正式保证仍然有限。

sentences.en: We study SD for ridge regression with an unconstrained mixing weight $\xi \in \mathbb{R}$.
sentences.zh: 我们研究带无约束混合权重 $ξ \in \mathbb{R}$ 的岭回归SD。

sentences.en: Conditional on the training data and without any distributional assumptions, we prove that for any squared prediction risk $R$ (including out-of-distribution), the optimally mixed student strictly improves upon the ridge teacher at every regularization level $\lambda$ where the teacher risk is not stationary ($R'(\lambda) \neq 0$).
sentences.zh: 以训练数据为条件且不做任何分布假设，我们证明对任何平方预测风险 $R$（包括分布外），在教师风险非平稳（$R'(λ) \neq 0$）的每个正则化水平 $λ$ 上，最优混合学生都严格优于岭教师。

sentences.en: We also characterize the optimal mixing weight $\xi^\star$ in terms of the risk derivative $R'$, showing that it can be negative, which is the case in over-regularized regimes.
sentences.zh: 我们还用风险导数 $R'$ 刻画最优混合权重 $ξ★$，表明它可以是负的，这在过正则化区间中是常见情况。

sentences.en: To quantify SD risk improvements, we derive exact risk asymptotics in the proportional asymptotics regime for general anisotropic covariance and deterministic signals.
sentences.zh: 为量化SD风险改进，我们在一般异向协方差和确定性信号的比例渐近区间内推导精确风险渐近。

sentences.en: From a practical standpoint, we propose a consistent one-shot tuning method to estimate $\xi^\star$ without grid search, sample splitting, or refitting.
sentences.zh: 从实用角度看，我们提出一种一致的单次调参方法来估计 $ξ★$，无需网格搜索、样本划分或重新拟合。

sentences.en: Experiments on real-world datasets and pretrained neural network features support our theory and the one-shot tuning method.
sentences.zh: 在真实世界数据集和预训练神经网络特征上的实验支持我们的理论和单次调参方法。
